園管局強調，下一階段將規劃導入「AI安全助手」，整合檢測數據、危害模擬及風險圖線，提供即時情資與應變策略建議。污水管理則將擴大於12處產業園區導入下水道水質水量自動監測、雨水道AI辨識監測及雲端大數據整合平台，建構更完整的智慧管網。
台水攜手國環院 聚焦五大核心導入AI檢測 守護飲水健康
台水公司董事長李嘉榮表示，隨著極端氣候與科技發展，飲用水水質管理面臨更多新型態挑戰。透過與國環院建立長期合作平台，能將研究成果與第一線供水場域緊密結合，強化檢測與水處理應用，讓科學研究落地實務。
台水與國環院透過這次結盟，將有效建立長期交流機制，不僅加速新興檢測技術落實，更能提升我國整體水質研究量能，為全台灣民眾建構更加永續且安心的優質飲水環境。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs announced two major smart water‑management achievements on Wednesday (Sept. 30), unveiling a comprehensive rollout of AI and cloud‑based big‑data technologies to create dual safety layers for industrial parks and public drinking water. First, the Park Management Bureau introduced AI‑driven pipeline risk identification and a smart sewage network, achieving up to a 29% reduction in energy consumption at wastewater treatment plants and a 20% cut in chemical‑use costs; on the civilian side, Taiwan Water Works partnered with the National Environmental Research Institute to fuse AI with emerging pollutant and algae monitoring, ushering water‑resource management into a new era of “pre‑identification and proactive warning.”
AI Empowers Industrial Pipeline Risk Alerts – Three Major Companies Implement Technological Protection

The Industrial Park Administration of the Ministry of Economic Affairs said that to improve industrial pipeline risk detection and response efficiency, it has built an “Industrial Pipeline Cloud Platform” that integrates basic data for seven pipeline categories, 69 pipelines, and more than one million pieces of imagery and inspection‑history records. By combining AI image recognition with leak‑dispersion simulation, the system has precisely identified high‑risk zones across five districts and 23 villages in Kaohsiung, overlaying nearby building and day‑night population data to anticipate potential impact areas and shift pipeline safety management toward proactive warning.

Companies are also actively adopting smart technologies. CPC Corp. developed an AI algorithm to assess pipeline corrosion trends and has completed comparisons for 21 pipelines in Kaohsiung; Formosa Plastics Corp. installed a smart leak‑detection system as part of the Phase‑II relocation of its Intercontinental plant’s pipelines; and Chang Chun Corp. integrated leak detection with an intelligent assistant, reducing leak‑response testing time to two minutes and keeping location error within 100 meters, demonstrating the tangible efficiency gains AI brings to abnormal‑event response.
Sewage‑Plant Smart Upgrade Saves 29% Energy – Expanding AI Safety Assistant to 12 Parks

In wastewater treatment, the Park Management Bureau used the Tucheng and Dajia‑Youshi industrial‑park sewage plants as pilot sites, installing mobile water‑quality and flow‑monitoring equipment linked to an intelligent cloud platform. After implementation, the suspended‑solid (SS) and chemical‑oxygen‑demand (COD) levels at both parks improved markedly, and the rate of water‑quality anomalies dropped sharply to between 2.3% and 2.39%. At the same time, chemical‑use costs fell by more than 20%, and electricity consumption per ton of treated sewage fell from 0.124 kWh to 0.088 kWh, a 29.03% energy saving that translates to roughly 7,000 kg of CO₂ reduction.

The bureau emphasized that the next phase will introduce an “AI Safety Assistant” that integrates inspection data, hazard simulations and risk maps to provide real‑time intelligence and response‑strategy recommendations. Wastewater management will be expanded to 12 industrial parks, deploying automatic sewage‑water quality and flow monitoring, AI‑based storm‑drain monitoring, and a cloud‑big‑data integration platform to build a more complete smart pipe network.
Taiwan Water Works Teams Up with the National Environmental Research Institute – Focusing on Five Core AI‑Based Tests to Protect Drinking‑Water Health

Taiwan Water Works Chairman Li Chia‑Jung said that with extreme weather and rapid technological progress, drinking‑water quality management faces increasingly novel challenges. By establishing a long‑term cooperation platform with the National Environmental Research Institute, research outcomes can be tightly linked to frontline water‑supply facilities, strengthening testing and treatment applications and turning scientific research into practical solutions.

Through this alliance, Taiwan Water Works and the National Environmental Research Institute will set up a lasting exchange mechanism that not only accelerates the deployment of emerging testing technologies but also boosts the nation’s overall water‑quality research capacity, building a more sustainable and trustworthy high‑quality drinking‑water environment for all of Taiwan’s residents.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉精確周漲逾2成 挑戰歷史前高價位
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Precision Gains Over 20% This Week, Challenging Historical High Price
paras: 車用零組件廠精確(3162-TW)喜迎第四季傳統旺季，並預期9月不會差，全年營收有望挑戰百億元新紀錄，本周股價上漲達21%，一度突破90元價位，逼近歷史前高價位97.8元。
精確主要出貨新能源車相關零組件，近年積極切入AI散熱相關產品和機器人版圖。
其中，對於散熱零件的分歧管、浸沒式機櫃、CDU和BBU 等產品，皆送樣認證中，目標透過與客戶的策略合作關係，在明年進一步取得更多水冷組件訂單。
精確表示，取得全球知名散熱品牌、散熱解決方案大廠 Cooler Master(訊凱國際)Vendor Code，正式成為其合格供應商。
而在車用本業上，精確積極掌握新能源車的成長趨勢，隨著主要客戶訂單持續放量，前8月合併營收65.44億元，年增33.42%，精確表示，福斯汽車(Volkswagen)和現代汽車(Hyundai)的訂單增加帶動歐洲廠產能利用率和營收明顯提升，同時，中國地區的廣州廠和湖州廠穩健成長。
惟因汽車產品的主要原物料鋁料價格年增超過3成，使精確上半年稅後純益788萬元，年減94%，每股純益(EPS)0.05元，精確力拚，最快第四季AI相關零件開始出量，明年起獲利力道可望轉強。
paras_en: Precision (3162‑TW), a automotive component maker, welcomed the traditional fourth‑quarter peak season and expects September to be no weaker. Full‑year revenue could challenge a new record of NT$10 billion. Its stock rose 21% this week, briefly breaking the NT$90 level and approaching its historic high of NT$97.8.
The company mainly ships components for new‑energy vehicles and has recently been actively entering the AI cooling product and robotics arenas.

Among its cooling‑related parts—such as split manifolds, immersion cabinets, CDU and BBU—samples are currently under certification. The goal is to leverage strategic partnerships with customers to secure more water‑cooling component orders next year.
Precision announced that it has obtained the vendor code of Cooler Master (Xun Kai International), a globally renowned cooling brand and solutions provider, officially becoming an approved supplier.

In its core automotive business, Precision is actively capturing the growth trend of new‑energy vehicles. With major customers expanding orders, consolidated revenue for the first eight months reached NT$6.544 billion, up 33.42% year‑on‑year. The company said orders from Volkswagen and Hyundai have boosted European plant capacity utilization and revenue, while its Guangzhou and Huzhou plants in China continued to grow steadily.

However, the price of aluminum, a key raw material for automotive products, rose more than 30% year‑on‑year, causing after‑tax net profit in the first half to fall to NT$7.88 million, a 94% decline, with earnings per share of NT$0.05. Precision is pushing hard, aiming to start shipping AI‑related parts as early as the fourth quarter, and expects profitability to strengthen from next year onward.

items.title: 美光加碼投資台灣、景氣燈號連9紅、亞馬遜參與金像電私募 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Micron Increases Investment in Taiwan, Economic Indicator Shows Nine Consecutive Red Lights, Amazon Joins Goldimage Electronics Private Placement – Weekly Highlights
paras: 美光台灣董事長盧東暉周四(2日)宣布，將在加碼投資台灣，進一步擴充HBM相關產能；國發會周二(29日)發布8月景氣概況，燈號連9紅；金像電周二(29日)宣布，發行私募現增股約1856張，總金額15.89億元，亞馬遜也參與此次私募案，以下為本周大事回顧：

〈美光加碼台灣〉美光台灣四大基地同步擴產 台中HBM先進封裝二廠本月啟用 

美光(MU-US)台灣董事長盧東暉周四(1日)表示，受惠AI帶動記憶體需求持續強勁，美光正加快全球擴產腳步，台灣桃園、台中、銅鑼及台南四大製造基地全面擴建與裝機，其中，台中新增的HBM先進封裝二廠預計10月中正式啟用，進一步擴充HBM相關產能。

〈景氣燈號〉連9紅！8月景氣對策信號連續3個月維持41分 領先與同時指標雙升 

國發會周二(29日)發布8月景氣概況，景氣對策信號綜合判斷分數為41分，與上月持平，燈號續呈紅燈，9項構成項目燈號均維持不變，同時領先指標與同時指標均續呈上升，顯示國內經濟維持穩健成長態勢。受惠於AI與雲端產業大幅提高資本支出、伺服器新品與自研晶片陸續量產，加上部分傳統產業受惠於AI外溢效果並進入出貨旺季，大幅維繫出口成長動能。投資方面，半導體供應鏈積極擴充高階製程與先進封裝產能，加上政府推動AI新十大建設，皆為民間投資增添成長動能；消費方面則在就業市場穩定、股市維持高檔的財富效果下，持續挹注內需成長。

金像電獲Amazon擲近16億元參與私募現增案 雙方合作更推進一步 

PCB 廠金像電 (2368-TW)周二(29日) 公布以每股856元發行私募現增股約1856張，募集約15.89億元，最受人矚目的是客戶端的亞馬遜(AMZN-US)參與此次私募案，這也是亞馬遜首度持有金像電股權，象徵雙方合作關係更爲密切。

9月台灣製造業PMI創逾5年新高 惟提防供應瓶頸和成本壓力升溫 

中華經濟研究院周四(1日)公布9月台灣製造業PMI指數續揚0.9個百分點至63.4%，創2021年8月以來新高，其中，電子暨光學產業續處高檔擴張，化學生技暨醫療和基礎原物料產業訂單逐漸升溫，中經院表示，整體製造業仍維持高速擴張，惟須留意供應瓶頸與成本壓力，正持續影響製造業生產和庫存配置。

台塑集團4公司攜手中華化合資新公司 雙方持股過半布局電子級硫酸廠 

中華化(1727-TW)及台塑集團旗下4間公司周二(29日)下午發重訊宣布，為拓展電子級硫酸事業，整合雙方資源，中華化擬與台塑集團的台塑(1301-TW)、台化(1303-TW)、台塑化(6505-TW)及台塑生醫科技共同投資設立合資新公司「台塑中華先進化學股份有限公司」，總資本額設定為新台幣60億元，中華化及台塑集團雙方將各自持股50%。

〈勞動基金績效〉前8月賺破2.3兆收益率近3成 新制勞退每人平均分紅衝上12.39萬元 

勞動基金運用局周四(1日)公布整體勞動基金最新績效，截至8月底，整體勞動基金規模達9兆1092億元，收益數為2兆3227億元，收益率高達29.45%。若加計受託管理的國民年金保險基金及農民退休基金，總運用規模一舉突破10兆大關，達10兆464億元，收益率為29.34%，收益數高達2兆5080億元。
其中，備受廣大勞工關注的新制勞工退休基金表現格外強勁，收益數衝至1兆6,236.3億元，收益率達29.25%；若以目前參與收益分配的新制勞退約1,310萬個有效帳戶計算，平均每位勞工帳面上可獲得約12.39萬元的收益紅利。
paras_en: Micron Taiwan Chairman Lu Donghui announced on Thursday (the 2nd) that the company will increase its investment in Taiwan, further expanding HBM‑related capacity; the National Development Council released the August economic outlook on Tuesday (the 29th) showing nine consecutive red‑light signals; Goldimage Electronics announced on Tuesday (the 29th) a private placement of about 1,856 new shares worth NT$1.589 billion, with Amazon also participating in the placement. Below is a review of the week’s major events:

Micron’s Taiwan operations are expanding at all four sites. Chairman Lu Donghui said that, driven by strong AI‑fueled memory demand, Micron is accelerating its global capacity build‑out. The Taoyuan, Taichung, Tongluo and Tainan factories are all being expanded and equipped. The new HBM advanced‑packaging plant in Taichung is slated to start operations in mid‑October, adding further HBM capacity.

The National Development Council’s August economic snapshot shows the composite policy‑signal score at 41 points, unchanged from the previous month, and the indicator light remains red for the ninth straight month. All nine component lights stayed the same, while both leading and coincident indicators continued to rise, indicating steady domestic economic growth. AI and cloud sectors are boosting capital spending, new servers and in‑house chips are entering mass production, and traditional industries are benefitting from AI spill‑overs and entering a peak‑season for shipments, sustaining export momentum. Investment is being driven by semiconductor supply‑chain expansion into advanced processes and packaging, as well as government AI infrastructure projects, while consumer demand is supported by a stable job market and a strong equity market.

PCB maker Goldimage Electronics (2368‑TW) announced on Tuesday (the 29th) a private placement of approximately 1,856 shares at NT$856 each, raising about NT$1.589 billion. The most notable participant is Amazon (AMZN‑US), marking its first equity stake in Goldimage and signalling a deeper partnership between the two companies.

The Taiwan Institute of Economic Research reported on Thursday (the 1st) that the September Taiwan Manufacturing PMI rose another 0.9 points to 63.4%, a five‑year high not seen since August 2021. The electronics and optics sector remained at the top of the expansion curve, while chemical‑biotech‑medical and basic raw‑materials orders warmed up. The institute cautioned that supply bottlenecks and rising cost pressures could still affect production and inventory decisions.

China Chemical (1727‑TW) and four subsidiaries of the Formosa Plastics Group announced on Tuesday (the 29th) a joint venture to develop an electronic‑grade sulfuric acid plant. The new company, Formosa‑China Advanced Chemicals Co., will have a total capital of NT$6 billion, with China Chemical and the Formosa group each holding a 50% stake.

The Labor Fund Administration released its performance figures for the first eight months on Thursday (the 1st). The total fund size reached NT$9.1092 trillion, generating a profit of NT$2.3227 trillion and a return of 29.45%. Including the National Pension Insurance Fund and the Farmers’ Retirement Fund, total assets under management surpassed NT$10 trillion (NT$10.0464 trillion) with a 29.34% return and a profit of NT$2.5080 trillion.

The newly introduced Labor Retirement Fund, closely watched by workers, posted a profit of NT$1.62363 trillion, a 29.25% return. With roughly 13.1 million active accounts, the average dividend per worker is about NT$123,900.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉立碁布局1.6T光模組有成Q4看旺 周漲12.3%創波段新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: LITE-ON Targets 1.6T Optical Modules, Sees Q4 Upswing, Weekly Rise 12.3% Hits New Wave‑high
paras: LED封裝廠立碁(8111-TW)受惠於積極跨足矽光子領域並直攻1.6T與3.2T高階光收發模組，加上第4季營運逐步回溫，激勵本周買盤大舉湧入，2日攻上漲停價85.8元，周漲幅約12%，周成交量約5萬張。
針對市場高度聚焦的矽光子業務，立碁跳過市場既有的單通道100G方案，直接鎖定單通道200G技術，從光引擎延伸至光收發模組，全面布局1.6T與3.2T高階規格。公司指出1.6T光模組要價千美元起跳，具備高技術門檻，一旦未來良率與經濟規模拉升，毛利率可望自40%起跳，中長期營收占比更上看五成以上。
立碁營運主要由既有紅外線光模組及政府標案支撐，紅外線產品鎖定500萬與800萬畫素以上規格，積極切入人工智慧影像辨識、車載與自動駕駛等高階市場。配合未來新事業產能建置，樹林無塵室初期數十K產能已陸續備妥，預期第4季整體營運將優於第3季，明年營收與獲利亦朝同步優於今年的方向邁進。
paras_en: LED packaging firm LITE-ON (8111‑TW) is benefiting from an aggressive push into the silicon‑photonics arena and a direct focus on high‑end 1.6Tb/s and 3.2Tb/s optical transceiver modules. With Q4 operations gradually warming up, buying pressure surged this week, lifting the stock to the daily limit price of NT$85.8 on the 2nd, a weekly gain of about 12% and roughly 50,000 contracts traded.

Regarding the market‑focused silicon‑photonics business, LITE-ON is skipping the existing single‑channel 100G solution and targeting the single‑channel 200G technology outright, extending from the optical engine to the transceiver module and fully deploying 1.6Tb/s and 3.2Tb/s high‑end specifications. The company notes that the 1.6Tb/s optical module starts at $1,000 per unit, carries a high technical barrier, and once yields and economies of scale improve, gross margins could start at 40%, with the mid‑to‑long‑term revenue share from this segment potentially exceeding 50%.

LITE-ON’s operations are mainly supported by its existing infrared optical modules and government contracts. Its infrared products target specifications of 5‑megapixel and 8‑megapixel and are actively entering high‑end markets such as AI image recognition, automotive and autonomous driving. In line with the upcoming new‑business capacity build‑out, the cleanroom in Shulin has already prepared an initial capacity of several tens of thousands units, and the company expects overall Q4 performance to surpass Q3, with next year’s revenue and profit also projected to exceed this year’s levels.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉晟銘電機櫃出貨逐季增Q4展望正面 周漲近1成收復季線關
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Shengming Electric’s Cabinet Shipments Rise Quarter‑over‑Quarter, Positive Q4 Outlook, Weekly Gain Near 10% Recovers Seasonal Trendline
paras: 伺服器機殼廠晟銘電(3013-TW)今年聚焦毛利水準較高機櫃業務，累計今年前8月L11系統整合業務營收比重達18%，加上輝達(NVDA-US)VR200放量出貨，第四季展望正面，激勵晟銘電本周漲近1成，收復季線關卡。
晟銘電本周漲幅9.7%，周五(2日)最高漲至94.3元，收92.7元，除站回90元關卡，也同步收復5日線及季線。至於三大法人本周籌碼動向，本周合計賣超1489張。
晟銘電今年前8月營收比重中，伺服器相關業務營收比重降至73%，主因為L11系統整合業務占比提高至18%，今年有8至9成的ODM專案由過去的機箱業務轉為機櫃業務，預期機櫃業務比重將持續提升，動能將延續至明年。
晟銘電補充，目前已完成輝達GB300、VR200等標準品機箱已開好模具，而第四季起VR200將陸續量產出貨，公司也參與其中，可望同步受惠，並帶動第四季營運，展望正面。
paras_en: Server chassis maker Shengming Electric (3013‑TW) is focusing this year on higher‑margin cabinet business. By the end of August, its L11 system‑integration segment accounted for 18% of total revenue, and with Nvidia (NVDA‑US) ramping up shipments of the VR200, the Q4 outlook is positive, spurring a near‑10% rise this week and a recovery of the seasonal trendline level.

This week Shengming Electric jumped 9.7%, hitting a high of NT$94.3 on Friday (the 2nd) and closing at NT$92.7. The stock broke back above the NT$90 barrier and also reclaimed its 5‑day and quarterly moving averages. Meanwhile, the three major institutional investors were net sellers this week, offloading a total of 1,489 lots.

In the first eight months of the year, server‑related revenue fell to 73% of total sales, mainly because the L11 system‑integration business grew to an 18% share. About 80‑90% of ODM projects that previously fell under chassis business have shifted to cabinet business this year, and the cabinet share is expected to keep rising, with momentum extending into next year.

Shengming Electric added that it has already completed tooling for standard‑product cases such as Nvidia’s GB300 and VR200. Starting in Q4, VR200 will be mass‑produced and shipped in batches, and the company will participate in that effort, which should benefit its Q4 operations and support a positive outlook.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉晶技車載及AI應用挑成長大樑 單周股價滾量大漲13.55%
items.title_en: Hot Stock: JingTech’s Automotive and AI Applications Become Growth Pillars, Weekly Stock Price Jumps 13.55%
paras: 受惠光通訊強勁需求推升，頻率元件族群表現亮眼。 石英元件大廠晶技(3042-TW)在光通訊石英振盪器(XO)接單傳出捷報，訂單能見度已一路排至 2027 年；加上 AI 與車載應用扮演成長雙引擎，帶動本周股價量增價揚，周漲幅達 13.55%、收在 230.5 元。目前日 K 線呈現多頭排列，蓄勢挑戰前高 249 元歷史天價。
晶技 2026 年 8 月營收達 14.15 億元，改寫 71 個月來新高，創下歷史同期新高；自結單月稅前盈餘 2.79 億元，月減 4.31%、年增 39.1%，單月每股稅前賺 0.82 元。累計 2026 年前 8 月稅前盈餘達 17.91 億元，年增 29.7%，每股稅前盈餘 5.27 元。
展望後市，9 月受惠手機應用出貨動能優於 8 月，預期單月整體營收將超越上月，進一步挑戰歷史同期新高。技術面來看，晶技本周成交量能充沛，股價收在 230.5 元且日系均線呈多頭排列，短線支撐可觀察 5 日線約 214.1 元位置。
paras_en: Benefiting from strong demand in optical communications, the frequency‑component segment performed brightly. Quartz‑component giant JingTech (3042‑TW) reported a breakthrough in orders for optical‑communication quartz oscillators (XO), with order visibility now extending through 2027. Coupled with AI and automotive applications serving as dual growth engines, the stock saw a sharp rise in price and volume this week, gaining 13.55% to close at NT$230.5. The daily candlestick chart now shows a bullish alignment, positioning the stock to challenge its historic high of NT$249.

JingTech’s revenue for August 2026 reached NT$1.415 billion, setting a 71‑month record and a new high for the same period in history. Pre‑tax earnings for the month were NT$279 million, down 4.31% month‑over‑month but up 39.1% year‑over‑year, equating to NT$0.82 pre‑tax earnings per share. Cumulatively, pre‑tax earnings for the first eight months of 2026 totaled NT$1.791 billion, a 29.7% year‑over‑year increase, or NT$5.27 per share.

Looking ahead, September is expected to benefit from stronger mobile‑application shipments compared with August, with monthly total revenue projected to exceed the prior month and potentially set a new historic high for the period. Technically, JingTech’s trading volume this week was robust, the stock closed at NT$230.5 and the daily moving averages remain in a bullish arrangement. Short‑term support can be watched around the 5‑day moving average at approximately NT$214.1.

items.title: 安成生技新藥AC-203迎來收割期！Q4關鍵解盲在即  點燃國際授權熱潮
items.title_en: AnCeng Biotech's New Drug AC-203 Enters Harvest Phase! Key Q4 Unblinding Ahead, Igniting Global Licensing Frenzy
paras: 國內知名新藥公司安成生技(6610-TW)旗下專為罕見疾病「遺傳性表皮分解性水皰症」（Epidermolysis Bullosa，”EB” ，俗稱泡泡龍症）所開發的創新藥物 AC-203，目前正推進至全球二/三期臨床試驗的最後階段。隨著試驗進入尾聲，市場高度聚焦預計於今年第四季即將迎來的關鍵解盲成果。若主要療效指標的統計數據順利達標，AC-203不僅有望成為全球首款 (First-in-Class) 針對單純型泡泡龍症（EB Simplex）的核准藥物，更將全面推進與國際大廠的全球授權談判及後續藥證申請。
全球數十萬名患者長期無藥可醫 龐大醫療需求推升千億商機

泡泡龍症是一種造成患者極大痛苦且具致命性的遺傳性罕見皮膚疾病，全球患者數約達 50 萬人，基於不同的基因變異分為幾種不同類型。其中，「單純型」（EB Simplex; “EBS”）佔整體患者比率約 70%（全球約 35 萬人），「失養型」（Dystrophic EB; “DEB”）」約佔四分之一，患者皮膚脆弱，容易產生水皰與傷口，部分重症類型甚至可能危及生命，「單純型」雖然死亡率相對較低，但頻繁發生的水皰與劇烈搔癢及疼痛對患者的生活品質造成極大困擾，且全球尚未有任何經過核准的治療用藥，患者長期面臨「無藥可醫」的窘境。

由於目前尚無有效的治療用藥，患者僅能依賴價格高昂的特殊敷料進行傷口照護並搭配症狀治療，來減輕痛苦與併發症風險，每年醫療與護理費用動輒高達十多萬美元。根據第三方市場研究報告 (Coherent Market Insights 2023 CMI Analysis)，單純型泡泡龍的藥物市場規模至 2030 年可達到 40 億美元。安成生技AC-203如能順利取得藥證，成為首款針對單純型泡泡龍症的治療用藥，滲透率有望達到50%或以上，相當於15-20億美元的潛在市場份額，參考國際同類型藥物或基因療法的極高定價（部分治療失養型泡泡龍症的基因療法年藥費甚至超過百萬美元），AC-203 未來上市後具備相當寬廣的市場潛力與成長空間。

安成生技在日前舉辦的全球線上國際研討會中，邀請了美國及歐洲知名的皮膚科權威醫師（key opinion leaders）參與，會中專家對於 AC-203用於治療EBS給予高度認可。美國西北大學費恩伯格醫學院皮膚科暨小兒科教授 Amy Paller尤為重視AC-203的發展潛力，甚至認為該藥物有望徹底改變目前的治療格局。她如此評價道：「I think it could be a game changer for our patients with EB simplex. It certainly looks great in the trials that we have seen so far. 」即「我認為這可能完全改變了 EBS的治療方法。 AC-203在臨床試驗中的表現確實令人鼓舞。」

安成生技指出，公司在罕見皮膚病症醫療專業領域的知名度與認可度極高，不僅是因為產品切中病理核心，更具體實踐了企業社會責任（ESG）。多年來，安成生技與各國的泡泡龍病友協會保持良好聯繫和互動。今年七月再度參與全球最主要的泡泡龍病友協會Debra of America舉辦的DEBRA Care Conference雙年會，在會議中正式發表關於AC-203研究進展的報告，並設立攤位與來自世界各地的藥廠、醫師、意見領袖、病友及家庭進行深入的互動交流，顯示安成生技對於泡泡龍症的積極投入不遺餘力。
延伸佈局「失養型」適應症 擴大產品線價值

除了主攻的單純型外，安成生技也同步將AC-203的適應症拓展至佔比約 20% 至 30%、病況更為嚴重的「失養型泡泡龍症」（DEB）市場。失養型患者的傷口通常更加難以癒合，長期呈開放性狀態且極易感染，也伴隨持續的嚴重疼痛；重度隱性失養型患者長期甚至可能發展為皮膚鱗狀細胞癌，因此目前仍存在高度未被滿足的醫療需求。雖然目前失養型已有少數治療方式，但這些療法涉及基因治療或細胞治療，不僅治療取得受到保險給付限制或是產能限制，相關治療成本也可能高達每年數十萬甚至上百萬美元。

安成生技近期宣布收到美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）針對旗下新藥 AC-203開發失養型遺傳性表皮分解性水皰症的 Type C 會議紀錄。此次與美國 FDA 進行法規諮詢，針對臨床設計、主要與次要療效指標及其評估方式等關鍵議題，皆獲得FDA正面且具體的回應。未來計畫利用單純型研究累積的數據為基礎，直接開展治療失養型的二/三期臨床試驗，預計最快於 2027 年下半年正式啟動。透過同一藥物延伸至不同適應症，有助於提升藥物整體的商業價值。
國際授權洽談熱絡 已與7家大廠展開深度接觸
隨著 AC-203 臨床進展接近收割期，安成生技在商務授權（Licensing-out）也取得實質進展。目前已知全球有 7 家國際級藥廠表達高度合作意願，其中 5 家已簽署保密協議（CDA），並有 3 家正在進行實質盡職調查。
安成生技表示，公司現階段的戰略核心為尋求「全球授權」，藉由國際大廠的資源與通路加速產品推向全球市場。隨著今年第四季解盲數據揭曉，已經授權地區：如中國、日本、韓國等區域，也將迎來數百萬美元的里程碑金入帳，歐美主力市場的授權談判也將加速發酵。
美國 PRV 政策加持 財務與授權潛力備受矚目
值得注意的是，AC-203具有罕見兒科疾病認證，受惠於美國「罕見兒科疾病優先審查憑證」（PRV）計畫，若未來順利取得藥證，將可獲得一張能將新藥的實質審查期由10個月縮短至 6 個月的加速通行證。
市場分析指出，PRV 不僅能協助新藥更快速搶佔市場商機，其在市場上更具備高度流通與轉售變現的價值（近年成交行情約落在 2 億美元之間）。目前台灣新藥公司以仁新醫藥(6696-TW)及安成生技(6610-TW)最有機會取得PRV。兩家公司目前仁新市值約1500億台幣，對比近期安成生技市值約83億台幣，若順利出售PRV憑證，其價值可達63億台幣，對安成生技將帶來極為顯著的財務挹注與股東權益提升。
總結來說，安成生技(6610-TW)正站在罕見疾病新藥開發的關鍵轉折點。隨著第四季解盲倒數計時，市場正密切檢視這項兼具社會公益（ESG）與龐大商業潛力的醫療突破，並期待其引領台灣生技實力再次站上國際舞台。
paras_en: AnCeng Biotech (6610-TW), a well‑known domestic new‑drug company, has its innovative drug AC-203—developed specifically for the rare disease hereditary epidermolysis bullosa (EB), commonly called "bubble‑dragon disease"—now in the final stage of global Phase II/III trials. As the trial nears completion, the market is intensely focused on the key unblinding results expected in Q4 of this year. If the primary efficacy endpoints meet statistical targets, AC-203 could become the world’s first First‑in‑Class approved therapy for EB Simplex and would drive worldwide licensing talks with major pharma and subsequent regulatory filings.
Hundreds of thousands of patients worldwide have long faced a lack of treatment, creating a massive medical need that could translate into a trillion‑dollar market opportunity.

EB is a painful, potentially fatal hereditary rare skin disorder affecting about 500,000 people globally, with several sub‑types based on genetic variants. EB Simplex (EBS) accounts for roughly 70% of cases (about 350,000 patients), while Dystrophic EB (DEB) makes up about a quarter. Patients suffer fragile skin, blisters and wounds; severe forms can be life‑threatening. Although EBS has a lower mortality rate, frequent blisters, intense itching and pain severely impair quality of life, and no approved therapy exists worldwide, leaving patients with “no drug” options.

Because no effective therapy exists, patients rely on costly specialty dressings and symptomatic care, with annual medical and nursing costs often exceeding $100,000. A third‑party market report (Coherent Market Insights 2023 CMI Analysis) estimates the EBS drug market could reach $4 billion by 2030. If AC‑203 obtains approval as the first EBS treatment, a market penetration of 50% or more would represent a $1.5‑$2 billion opportunity, given the high pricing of comparable international drugs and gene therapies (some DEB gene therapies exceed $1 million per year), indicating substantial growth potential for AC‑203.

At a recent global online symposium, AnCeng Biotech invited leading dermatology key opinion leaders from the U.S. and Europe. Experts gave strong endorsement to AC‑203 for EBS. Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine professor of dermatology and pediatrics Amy Paller highlighted the drug’s potential, stating, “I think it could be a game changer for our patients with EB simplex. It certainly looks great in the trials that we have seen so far.”

AnCeng Biotech notes its high reputation in rare skin disease therapeutics, not only because its product targets the disease’s core pathology but also because it fulfills corporate social responsibility (ESG). The company maintains close ties with EB patient associations worldwide. In July, it participated again in the DEBRA Care Conference, the premier global EB patient meeting, presenting AC‑203 research updates and hosting a booth for in‑depth interaction with pharma companies, physicians, opinion leaders, patients and families, underscoring its relentless commitment to EB.
Extending into the DEB indication to broaden product line value

Beyond EBS, AnCeng Biotech is expanding AC‑203’s indication to the more severe Dystrophic EB (DEB) market, which represents about 20‑30% of patients. DEB wounds heal poorly, remain open, are prone to infection and cause chronic severe pain; severe recessive DEB can even progress to skin squamous cell carcinoma, leaving a large unmet medical need. Existing DEB therapies involve gene or cell therapy, which face insurance coverage limits, manufacturing constraints and costs that can reach hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars per year.

AnCeng Biotech recently announced receipt of a Type C meeting record from the U.S. FDA regarding AC‑203’s development for DEB. The regulatory consultation covered clinical design, primary and secondary endpoints and their assessment, and the FDA provided positive, concrete feedback. The company plans to leverage data from the EBS program to launch Phase II/III DEB trials as early as the second half of 2027, using the same molecule to increase overall commercial value.
Licensing talks are heating up, with deep engagement from seven major pharma firms

As AC‑203 approaches the harvest phase, AnCeng Biotech has made tangible progress on licensing‑out. Seven international pharmaceutical companies have expressed strong interest, five have signed confidentiality agreements (CDAs) and three are conducting substantive due‑diligence.

AnCeng Biotech says its current strategic core is to secure “global licensing,” leveraging the resources and distribution networks of major international partners to accelerate worldwide rollout. With Q4 unblinding data imminent, regions already licensed—such as China, Japan and South Korea—are expected to generate milestone payments in the millions of dollars, while negotiations in the U.S. and Europe are set to accelerate.
U.S. PRV policy boost highlights financial and licensing potential

Notably, AC‑203 has received rare pediatric disease designation and qualifies for the U.S. Priority Review Voucher (PRV) program. If approved, the voucher would cut the standard review timeline from ten months to six months.

Analysts note that PRVs not only speed market entry but also have high tradable value, with recent transactions around $200 million. In Taiwan, the companies most likely to obtain a PRV are Renxin Pharma (6696‑TW) and AnCeng Biotech (6610‑TW). Renxin’s market cap is about NT$150 billion, while AnCeng’s is roughly NT$83 billion; a PRV sale could fetch up to NT$63 billion, providing a significant financial boost and enhancing shareholder value.

In summary, AnCeng Biotech (6610‑TW) stands at a pivotal turning point in rare‑disease drug development. With the Q4 unblinding countdown underway, the market is closely watching this breakthrough that blends social good (ESG) with massive commercial potential, and anticipates it will once again showcase Taiwan’s biotech strength on the global stage.

items.title: 牛市警訊浮現！僅25%標普成分股站上50日線 結構急劇惡化
items.title_en: Bull Market Warning Emerges! Only 25% of S&P 500 Stocks Above 50-Day Line, Structure Deteriorates Sharply
paras: 美股整體指數雖持續維持在歷史高點附近，但若仔細剖析市場內部的流動性與結構，大盤榮景背後正悄然浮現一項重大紅燈警訊：投資人對於「持續看多」的信心正急劇流失。
財經機構《Kobeissi Letter》最新報告指出，目前標普500指數 (S&P 500) 成分股中，僅有 25% 的股票成交價高於其 50 日均線 (MA)，創下今年 4 月以來的最低比例。與今年 8 月中旬高達 70% 的榮景相比，大盤結構出現了令人瞠目結舌的急劇惡化。
除了短期均線潰敗，中長期趨勢同樣不容樂觀。
目前標普僅有 47% 的成分股維持在 200 日均線上方，同樣寫下近半年新低。
此外，截至本週一收盤，紐約證券交易所 (NYSE) 已連續 10 個交易日「創 52 週新低」的個股數量超越「創 52 週新高」者。
在過去 15 個交易日中，更有高達 14 天呈現此類異常警訊。
「市場參與廣度 (Market Breadth) 正以驚人的速度急劇惡化。」《Kobeissi Letter》團隊警告，雖然這未必代表市場即將迎來終極拋售潮，但在未來數週內絕對值得投資人高度提防。
健康的大牛市通常伴隨著廣泛的板塊輪動與個股齊揚。如今「市場廣度惡化」，意味著越來越少的股票能夠支撐指數的高位運作。
回顧第三季，市場資金明顯從受制於高利率與高大宗商品價格的跨國企業撤出，轉而龜縮回抱輝達 (NVDA-US)、Meta (META-US) 等「科技七巨頭」龍頭個股，呈現高度集中化的避險防禦心態。
不過，市場並非全然籠罩在陰霾之中。強勁的企業獲利表現仍是當前股市的重要支柱，如記憶體晶片大廠美光 (MU-US) 最新公布的亮眼財報便提供了有力佐證。
針對當前紛擾的市場氛圍，投資研究機構《SentimentTrader》策略師 Jay Kaeppel 分析：「看空者固然可以列舉出一連串理由——高利率、高估值、糧食與能源價格飛漲、政府債務赤字、大選不確定性以及地緣政治衝突等。但在這些壓力下感到焦慮是正常的，歷史規律表明，市場的『長期歷史天花板』極少在極度狂熱出現前形成。」
Kaeppel 進一步指出，目前市場遠未達到「全員登上瘋狂牛車」的狂熱狀態。
因此，儘管市場廣度惡化與高利率環境預示著美股短期內可能面臨陣痛與修正，但從投資人情緒指標來看，大盤長期運行的多頭頂部可能尚未真正到來。
paras_en: U.S. equity indices remain near historic highs, but a close look at internal liquidity and structure reveals a major red flag: investor confidence in a continued rally is eroding rapidly.

The latest Kobeissi Letter report notes that only 25% of S&P 500 constituents are trading above their 50‑day moving average, the lowest share since April this year. This is a stark contrast to the mid‑August peak of about 70%, indicating a dramatic structural decline.
In addition to the short‑term moving‑average collapse, the medium‑ to long‑term trend is equally bleak.
Only 47% of S&P 500 stocks are now above their 200‑day moving average, also a six‑month low.
Furthermore, as of Monday’s close, the NYSE has seen more stocks make 52‑week lows for ten consecutive trading days than make 52‑week highs.
In the past 15 trading days, this abnormal signal has occurred on as many as 14 days.
"Market breadth is deteriorating at an alarming pace," the Kobeissi Letter team warned. While this may not signal an imminent sell‑off, investors should be on high alert over the coming weeks.

A healthy bull market is usually characterized by broad sector rotation and many stocks pulling the index higher. The current breadth deterioration means fewer stocks are supporting the index’s elevated levels.

Looking back at Q3, capital shifted away from multinational firms weighed down by high rates and commodity prices toward a handful of tech giants such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Meta (META‑US), reflecting a highly concentrated defensive stance.
Nevertheless, the market is not entirely gloomy. Strong corporate earnings remain a key pillar, as demonstrated by Micron Technology’s (MU‑US) impressive latest earnings report.

Commenting on the turbulent market mood, SentimentTrader strategist Jay Kaeppel said, "Bearish investors can list a litany of reasons—high rates, lofty valuations, soaring food and energy prices, government debt deficits, election uncertainty and geopolitical conflicts—but feeling anxious under these pressures is normal. History shows that the market’s long‑term ceiling rarely forms before extreme euphoria takes hold."
Kaeppel added that the market is far from the manic "everyone on the crazy bull cart" frenzy.

Thus, while worsening breadth and a high‑rate environment suggest U.S. equities may face short‑term pain and corrections, sentiment indicators imply that a long‑term bullish top may not have fully materialized yet.

items.title: 三星HBM4報價逾前代3倍 搶攻AI記憶體定價權
items.title_en: Samsung HBM4 Pricing Over Triple That of Previous Generation, Seeks AI Memory Pricing Power
paras: 據韓國《每日經濟》週五 (2 日) 報導，三星向主要客戶提出的 2027 年 HBM4 供貨報價，落在每 Gb 4 美元的中高價位，超過目前 HBM3E 約 1.50 美元的 3 倍。
三星電子 (005930-KR) 擬以新一代高頻寬記憶體 (HBM4) 的效能優勢拉高售價，挑戰 SK 海力士主導的市場格局。
《每日經濟》引述半導體業界人士指出，三星已展開明年度 HBM4 年度供貨合約談判，希望在產品世代交替之際，將較高的傳輸速度與穩定供貨能力轉化為價格溢價，提升獲利能力。
以效能拉高報價 年度價格談判進入尾聲
三星此次報價的主要支撐，來自對 HBM4 效能的信心。
三星 HBM4 可穩定達到每秒 11.7 Gb 的資料傳輸速度，最高可達每秒 13 Gb，並稱其處於業界最高水準。
不同於一般 DRAM，HBM 主要透過年度長期合約供貨。客戶會提前與製造商協商下一年度的採購量與價格，以確保取得所需供應，製造商則依據訂單安排生產。
據報導，明年度主要 HBM 供貨量已有相當部分完成協商，價格談判預計將在本月進入最後階段。
不過，三星目前提出的是供貨報價，最終成交價格仍取決於與客戶的談判結果。
HBM4 推升競爭門檻 速度與功耗成定價關鍵
隨著 AI 加速器對記憶體效能的要求提高，HBM 市場的競爭重點也逐漸改變。
過去，供應商首先必須通過輝達 (NVDA-US) 等主要客戶的認證、打入供應鏈，再擴大出貨規模。進入 HBM4 世代後，即使是同一代產品，傳輸速度與功耗效率的差異，也將愈來愈影響價格。
三星希望藉此強化競爭力。SK 海力士 (000660-KR) 過去在 HBM 市場居於領先地位，三星則試圖透過更高規格的產品，爭取客戶接受較高售價，並擴大自身的市場影響力。
AI 需求與供應吃緊 支撐價格上行
除了產品效能，AI 基礎建設投資持續擴張，也為 HBM 報價提供支撐。需求快速成長，但供應仍有限，加上 HBM4 將逐步取代現有主力產品，有利於高階產品維持價格溢價。
報導引述研調機構 TrendForce 預測，受 HBM4 占比提高及供應短缺推動，2027 年 HBM 平均售價將較今年上漲 121%。美光 (MU-US) 也在近期財報電話會議中，提及明年 HBM 價格可能大幅上漲。
這項平均售價預測同時反映產品組合轉向價格較高的 HBM4，以及供需吃緊的影響，並不代表所有 HBM 產品都將調漲相同幅度。
隨著三星擴大 HBM4 供應，市場競爭預料將進一步升溫。三星能否讓客戶接受效能溢價，並將技術表現轉化為穩定量產與市占率成長，將成為明年 HBM 市場的觀察重點。
paras_en: According to South Korea's Daily Economy on Friday (the 2nd), Samsung's proposed 2027 HBM4 supply price to major customers falls in the mid‑high range of $4 per gigabyte, more than three times the current HBM3E premium of about $1.50 per gigabyte.
Samsung Electronics (005930-KR) plans to leverage the performance advantage of its next‑generation high‑bandwidth memory (HBM4) to raise prices and challenge the market dominance of SK Hynix.

The Daily Economy quoted semiconductor industry sources saying Samsung has already begun negotiations for HBM4 supply contracts for next year, hoping to convert higher transfer speeds and stable supply capability into price premiums as the product generation shifts, thereby boosting profitability.
Using performance to lift pricing, annual price negotiations are entering the final stage
The main support for Samsung's current pricing comes from confidence in HBM4 performance.
Samsung's HBM4 can consistently achieve a data transfer rate of 11.7 Gb/s, peaking at 13 Gb/s, which the company claims is among the industry's highest levels.

Unlike typical DRAM, HBM is primarily supplied through long‑term annual contracts. Customers negotiate next‑year purchase volumes and prices in advance to secure supply, while manufacturers schedule production based on those orders.
The report says a substantial portion of next year’s main HBM supply volume has already been negotiated, and price talks are expected to enter their final phase this month.
However, Samsung’s current figure is a supply quote; the final transaction price will still depend on negotiations with customers.
HBM4 raises the competitive barrier, with speed and power consumption becoming key pricing factors
As AI accelerators demand higher memory performance, the competitive focus in the HBM market is shifting.

In the past, suppliers first had to pass certification by major customers such as Nvidia (NVDA-US) and enter the supply chain before scaling shipments. In the HBM4 era, even within the same generation, differences in transfer speed and power‑efficiency will increasingly affect pricing.

Samsung aims to strengthen its competitiveness. SK Hynix (000660-KR) has historically led the HBM market, but Samsung is trying to win customers over with higher‑spec products, command higher prices, and expand its market influence.
AI demand and tight supply support price increases

Beyond product performance, continued expansion of AI infrastructure investment also underpins HBM pricing. Demand is growing rapidly while supply remains limited, and as HBM4 gradually replaces existing flagship products, it helps premium products maintain price premiums.

Citing research firm TrendForce, the report forecasts that driven by a higher share of HBM4 and supply shortages, the average HBM price in 2027 will be 121% higher than this year’s. Micron (MU-US) also mentioned in a recent earnings call that next year’s HBM prices could rise sharply.

This average price forecast reflects both the shift toward higher‑priced HBM4 in the product mix and the impact of tight supply, and does not imply that all HBM products will see the same price increase.

As Samsung expands HBM4 supply, market competition is expected to heat up further. Whether Samsung can get customers to accept the performance premium and turn technical performance into stable mass production and market‑share growth will be a key focus for the HBM market next year.

items.title: 馬斯克帝國本周全線狂飆 長期伴侶卻突宣布「被分手」
paras: 特斯拉(Tesla)(TSLA-US)週五(2日)交出了近期最漂亮的單日表現，收漲4.65%，報370.59美元。截至本週初，特斯拉今年累計下跌約21%，在所有科技巨頭中墊底，而這一次，終於迎來一份超出華爾街預期的成績單。
但特斯拉的大漲，只是馬斯克這周的縮影。一周之內，馬斯克幾乎講全了他所有的核心敘事：電動車、自動駕駛、電動卡車、太空、AI算力、超級高鐵，以及政商關係。同時，他的私人生活也再次成為輿論焦點。
點燃股價的，是週五公佈的第三季交付數據。特斯拉本季交付486,532輛。此前，市場普遍不看好：分析師一致預期只有461,974輛，高盛的預測更低，僅約43.5萬輛。最終，實際交付比一致預期多出約2.5萬輛。
這份成績單還有幾個亮點：
庫存清空：交付量比產量多出約2.2萬輛，第一季積壓的約5萬輛超額庫存已基本消化
歐洲回暖：歐洲銷量從去年的低迷中恢復，彌補了美國和中國兩大市場的疲軟
儲能增長：儲能裝機13.7GWh，同比增長9.6%
華爾街的態度明顯轉暖。摩根士丹利認為，特斯拉可能正在「走出電動車寒冬」。

Semi卡車遲到7年終於量產

交付超預期之前，特斯拉已經有好消息。9月24日，Semi電動卡車在內華達州正式開啓大規模量產，首批車輛交付給百事、DHL和US Foods。這家專屬工廠年產能為5萬輛，目標是每周生產1,000輛。就在量產前幾天，特斯拉還贏得了一個最多2,500輛的採購項目，這是Semi迄今為止最大的訂單。
從2017年發佈到實現量產，Semi整整等了7年。
擴產所需的資金也已到位。9月29日，特斯拉宣佈獲得300億美元新信貸額度，用於Cybercab、Optimus和Semi的規模化生產，其中花旗提供200億美元。公司表示，今年不打算動用這些額度。

Starship第14次試飛 終於進入軌道

如果說特斯拉是本週最受關注的消息，那麼SpaceX(SPCX-US)就是本週最具分量的突破。週一，Starship第14次試飛首次進入地球軌道，並部署了全部26顆Starlink V3衛星。過程並不完美：一台發動機在上升階段熄火，原計劃10小時的任務也縮短到約3小時。但核心目標已經達成。
為什麼這步如此關鍵？此前所有Starship試飛都只能走亞軌道路線，最終要麼濺落，要麼在部分測試中損毀。而V3衛星體積太大，Falcon 9無法搭載，只能依賴Starship。每顆V3衛星的下行帶寬超過1Tbps，遠超目前在軌的V2 Mini衛星。
週四，SpaceX又將四名太空人送往國際太空站，執行NASA的Crew-13任務，同時把一顆Google衛星送入軌道。三次任務加起來，SpaceX在約13小時內實現了三次入軌發射。
Google這顆名為Suncatcher的衛星，正測試在軌運行的AI運算硬體，這正是馬斯克一直描繪的「太空算力」圖景。馬斯克本人也在週四晚間透露，憑借與輝達的深度聯合設計，SpaceX有望在其AI硬體上實現一個「大突破」。
週五，SpaceX盤中一度大漲超過7%。摩根士丹利維持「增持」評級和300美元目標價，並認為下一次試飛如果能成功回收飛船，可能成為SpaceX上市以來最大的股價催化劑。

馬斯克再次喊話「超級高鐵」

9月20日，馬斯克在X上表示，Boring Company正在奧斯汀和聖安東尼奧之間建設一條「簡易版的超級高鐵前身隧道」，時速超過200英里，可以把最長約2個半小時的車程穩定縮短到30分鐘以內。
這次與過去最大的不同在於資金。本月早些時候，Boring Company剛完成一輪由阿聯酋投資者領投的30億美元融資，估值約230億美元。
但這個項目目前仍處於非常早期的階段：沒有公佈線路、時間表或造價，也沒有任何公開承諾。兩地交通官員表示，在馬斯克發文前從未與他或Boring Company有過接觸。
馬斯克在2013年首次提出超級高鐵構想。十多年過去，全球仍沒有一條真正載客運營的超級高鐵。這一次，錢已經到位，接下來要看行動。

從白宮主桌到五角大廈

9月29日，川普在白宮舉辦AI午宴。座位圖顯示，馬斯克與輝達CEO黃仁勳分坐川普兩側。
次日，馬斯克又獲得一項新職務：他將與Anduril創辦人Palmer Luckey和前眾議院議長金里奇共同領導五角大廈的「子午線計劃」（Project Meridian）。這是一項為期120天的研究，旨在確定美軍未來作戰所需的新領域和防務技術。

與長期伴侶分手

就在特斯拉公佈交付數據的同一天，馬斯克的私人生活也上了頭條。
週五，馬斯克的長期伴侶、Neuralink高階主管Zilis在X上發文宣佈兩人分手，並稱是馬斯克在毫無預兆情況下結束了這段關係。她寫道，一周之內從相愛到放手很難，但有時事情就是這樣。
Zilis曾在OpenAI工作，與馬斯克育有四個孩子。她在聲明中表示，這四個孩子是兩人多年相處中最重要結晶。
Zilis在回應一條有關馬斯克取消關注她的發文時，透露了分手消息。她寫道，「在毫無預兆的情況下，一周之內從相愛走到被分手，很難接受，但有時事情就是這樣。」她稱自己會非常想念馬斯克。
在這份告別聲明中，Zilis回顧了兩人相處的經歷。她表示，自己曾努力給馬斯克提供穩定、溫和的愛，希望他在繁忙且充滿衝突的生活之外，擁有一個能夠安心休息的地方。
儘管感到失落，Zilis仍感謝兩人共同擁有的四個孩子，並表示希望今後能夠與馬斯克成為好朋友，共同承擔養育責任。「我很難過，但仍深深關心他，也會一直祝福他幸福。」
Zilis還隨聲明發佈了一張日期為9月24日的訊息對話截圖。據《富比世》報導，截圖中，她告訴馬斯克，很高興與他一起吃早餐，並表達愛意，馬斯克回覆稱，他也愛她。
Zilis擔任Neuralink營運與特別專案主管，畢業於耶魯大學，擁有機器學習和AI領域工作背景。她曾於2017年至2019年在特斯拉任職，也曾擔任OpenAI顧問及董事會成員，早早登上富比世30 Under 30精英榜。

items.title: 美非農僅增2.9萬人壓低升息預期 那斯達克漲1.19%、Tesla勁揚4.7%
items.title_en: U.S. Nonfarm Payrolls Rise Only 29,000, Dampening Rate-Hike Expectations; Nasdaq Up 1.19%, Tesla Soars 4.7%
paras: 2026年10月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國9月就業成長遠低於市場預期，進一步壓低聯準會10月底升息機率，美股周五全面收高，其中那斯達克綜合指數上漲1.19%，大型科技股領漲，對利率較敏感的小型股與房地產類股同步走強。
美國勞工部公布，9月非農就業人口僅增加2.9萬人，遠低於經濟學家預估的9萬人，前兩個月數據也遭大幅下修。就業市場降溫，使投資人進一步降低對聯準會短期升息的押注。
根據CME FedWatch數據，市場預估聯準會10月底會議升息至少25個基點的機率降至22.7%，低於前一交易日的24.4%，更較一周前的64.2%大幅下降。
SummitTX Capital交易主管Robert Bernstone表示，就業數據顯示美國經濟並未過熱，有助降低短期升息風險，但市場仍須面對經濟成長與通膨疑慮，目前投資氣氛可視為審慎樂觀。
利率預期降溫也帶動對利率敏感的族群。標普500房地產類股上漲0.4%，小型股Russell 2000指數上漲0.9%，創一個月來最大單日漲幅。
大型科技股則是推升指數的主要力量之一。輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US)上漲1.3%，特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)勁揚4.7%，兩家公司均為標普500指數主要正貢獻個股。Tesla走強也帶動標普500非必需消費類股上漲1.4%，成為11大類股中表現最佳族群。
市場本周原本就持續調降升息預期，除了近期經濟活動仍具韌性、物價漲幅低於預期外，兩名聯準會高層官員也對再次升息表達審慎態度，最新非農數據則進一步強化市場對10月暫緩升息的預期。
不過，從周線來看，美股表現仍然分化。標普500本周下跌0.27%，道瓊下跌1.26%，兩者均為最近5周中的第4周收黑；那斯達克則上漲0.45%，為最近6周中的第5周上漲。
個股方面，Nike(NKE-US)下跌3.6%，為道瓊成分股中表現最弱個股。公司受到中國市場需求疲弱影響，預估全年營收將出現意外的大幅下滑，同時宣布裁員並調整全球事業部門架構。
資料儲存類股則出現重挫。日經報導，日本Toshiba計畫在2027會計年度內，將AI資料中心使用的硬碟產能提高一倍，引發市場對供給增加的疑慮，Western Digital(WDC-US)與Seagate Technology(STX-US)雙雙重挫約10%，成為標普500科技類股中表現最差的個股。
市場廣度仍偏多，紐約證交所上漲與下跌家數比為1.67比1，那斯達克則為1.34比1。不過，那斯達克當天有57檔股票創52周新高，同時有224檔跌至52周新低；標普500則有11檔創52周新高、20檔創52周新低。
美國交易所全天成交量約169.3億股，低於過去20個交易日完整交易時段平均的172.8億股。

paras_en: On October 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. September job growth fell far short of market expectations, further lowering the odds of a Federal Reserve rate hike at the end of October. All major U.S. equity indexes closed higher on Friday, with the Nasdaq Composite gaining 1.19%, led by large‑cap tech stocks, while rate‑sensitive small‑cap and real‑estate stocks also rallied.

The U.S. Labor Department reported that non‑farm payrolls increased by only 29,000 in September, well below economists’ forecast of 90,000, and the figures for the prior two months were also sharply revised down. A cooling labor market has led investors to further reduce bets on a short‑term Fed rate hike.

According to CME FedWatch data, the market’s probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points at its October meeting fell to 22.7%, down from 24.4% the previous trading day and sharply lower than the 64.2% probability a week earlier.

SummitTX Capital trading head Robert Bernstone said the employment data shows the U.S. economy is not overheating, which helps lower short‑term rate‑hike risk, but the market still has to contend with growth and inflation concerns; the current investment sentiment can be described as cautiously optimistic.

All U.S. indexes closed higher: the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 250.40 points, or 0.49%, to 51,176.96; the S&P 500 gained 56.27 points, or 0.73%, to 7,722.72; and the Nasdaq Composite climbed 319.27 points, or 1.19%, to 27,190.86.

The easing of rate‑hike expectations also lifted rate‑sensitive groups. S&P 500 real‑estate stocks rose 0.4%, and the small‑cap Russell 2000 index jumped 0.9%, marking its biggest single‑day gain in a month.

Large‑cap tech stocks were a key driver of the index gains. Nvidia (NVDA‑US) rose 1.3% and Tesla (TSLA‑US) surged 4.7%; both are major positive contributors to the S&P 500. Tesla’s strength also lifted S&P 500 consumer discretionary stocks 1.4%, making the sector the best‑performing of the eleven major groups.

The market had already been trimming rate‑hike expectations this week, citing resilient economic activity, inflation running below forecasts, and cautious comments from two senior Fed officials. The latest non‑farm payroll data further reinforced expectations of a pause in rate hikes in October.

However, on a weekly basis U.S. equity performance remains mixed. The S&P 500 fell 0.27% and the Dow slipped 1.26% this week, marking the fourth losing week in the past five for both; the Nasdaq, by contrast, rose 0.45%, its fifth gain in six weeks.

On the stock‑specific front, Nike (NKE‑US) dropped 3.6%, making it the weakest performer among Dow components. The company cited weak demand in China, forecasting an unexpectedly large decline in full‑year revenue, and announced layoffs and a restructuring of its global business units.

Data‑storage stocks suffered steep declines. According to Nikkei, Japan’s Toshiba plans to double hard‑drive capacity for AI data centers by fiscal 2027, raising supply‑side concerns. Western Digital (WDC‑US) and Seagate Technology (STX‑US) each fell about 10%, becoming the worst‑performing tech stocks in the S&P 500.

Market breadth remained bullish, with a NYSE advance‑to‑decline ratio of 1.67 to 1 and a Nasdaq ratio of 1.34 to 1. On that day, 57 Nasdaq stocks hit 52‑week highs while 224 fell to 52‑week lows; the S&P 500 saw 11 stocks reach 52‑week highs and 20 hit 52‑week lows.
U.S. exchanges traded roughly 16.93 billion shares throughout the day, below the 20‑day average full‑session volume of 17.28 billion shares.
