items.title: 東芝擬HDD產能翻倍 希捷、威騰雙雙暴跌逾10%
items.title_en: Toshiba Plans to Double HDD Capacity; Seagate and Western Digital Both Plunge Over 10%
paras: 《日經亞洲》報導，東芝 (Toshiba) 計劃投資 3.8 億美元擴建菲律賓廠區，將資料中心用硬碟 (HDD) 產能提高至目前的 2 倍。消息衝擊同業股價，對手希捷科技 (STX-US) 狂瀉 10.21%，威騰電子 (WDC-US) 也暴跌 10%。
不過，分析師指出，擴產仍受上游供應能力與建置時程限制，兩家美系大廠的長期供貨合約也有助降低短期衝擊。
據報導，東芝計畫投入約 600 億日元，約合 3.8 億美元，擴充菲律賓硬碟生產設施，為該公司約 5 年來首度進行重大硬碟投資，藉此搶攻 AI 與雲端資料中心的儲存需求。
東芝 2 日發布的官方公告進一步說明，菲律賓子公司目標在 2027 財年，即截至 2028 年 3 月的年度，將年度產能以儲存容量計算，提高至 2025 財年的近 2 倍。這項目標衡量的是硬碟可提供的總儲存容量，並非生產顆數翻倍。公司位於 Laguna Technopark 的擴充產線已開始生產近線硬碟，並完成首批出貨。
AI 基礎建設投資帶動大量資料儲存需求，硬碟供應吃緊也支撐希捷與威騰的定價能力。東芝擴產消息因此促使投資人重新評估，未來供需變化是否會壓抑兩家公司的毛利率成長。
瑞穗交易部門分析師 Jordan Klein 表示，東芝最終能增加多少產能、需要多久才能達成，仍有不確定性。新增供給可能提高大型雲端業者的議價能力，但他預期，對合約協商的影響可能要到 2028 年才會浮現。
Klein 也指出，希捷具備技術優勢，加上目前硬碟需求仍高於供給，他尚不擔心客戶迅速轉向其他供應商。
Evercore ISI 分析師 Amit Daryanani 則表示，希捷與威騰 2027 年供應量已有合約承接，2028 年多數供應量也已分配給客戶。他認為，投資人應關注硬碟業者的供給紀律，以及長期需求能否延續。
此外，Daryanani 指出，東芝擴產速度取決於玻璃等上游零組件供應商能否同步增加產能，希捷與威騰則自行生產部分零組件。東芝擴產雖為產業競爭增添變數，但新增供給何時能實際投入市場，以及對報價與獲利的影響程度，仍有待觀察。
paras_en: Nikkei Asia reported that Toshiba plans to invest $380 million to expand its plant in the Philippines, aiming to double the data‑center HDD capacity it currently produces. The news sent rival stocks tumbling, with Seagate Technology (STX‑US) plunging 10.21% and Western Digital (WDC‑US) also dropping 10%.

However, analysts note that the expansion remains constrained by upstream supply capacity and construction timelines, and long‑term supply contracts held by the two U.S. giants should help cushion the short‑term impact.

According to the report, Toshiba intends to spend about ¥60 billion (roughly $380 million) to enlarge its Philippine HDD production facilities, marking the company’s first major HDD investment in about five years as it seeks to capture storage demand from AI and cloud data centers.

In an official notice released on the 2nd, Toshiba explained that its Philippine subsidiary targets the FY2027 fiscal year—ending March 2028—to raise annual capacity, measured in storage volume, to nearly twice the FY2025 level. The target refers to total storage capacity, not a doubling of unit count. The expanded line at its Laguna Technopark site has already begun producing near‑line drives and has shipped the first batch.

AI‑infrastructure spending is driving massive data‑storage demand, tightening HDD supply and supporting Seagate’s and Western Digital’s pricing power. Toshiba’s expansion news has prompted investors to reassess whether future supply‑demand shifts might suppress the two rivals’ margin growth.

Mizuho trading‑desk analyst Jordan Klein said there is still uncertainty about how much capacity Toshiba can ultimately add and how long it will take to achieve it. The new supply could boost the bargaining power of large cloud providers, but he expects any impact on contract negotiations to materialise only around 2028.
Klein also pointed out that Seagate enjoys a technology advantage and, with HDD demand still outpacing supply, he is not worried about customers quickly switching to other suppliers.

Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani said Seagate and Western Digital already have contracts covering their 2027 supply volumes, and most of the 2028 supply is also allocated to customers. He believes investors should watch the manufacturers’ supply discipline and whether long‑term demand can be sustained.

Daryanani added that Toshiba’s expansion speed depends on whether upstream component makers such as glass suppliers can scale output in step, whereas Seagate and Western Digital produce some components in‑house. While Toshiba’s build‑out adds a new variable to industry competition, the timing of actual market entry for the added supply and its effect on pricing and profitability remain to be seen.

items.title: Netflix陷低潮 今年暴跌26% 美國收視降8.6% 德意志銀行仍喊買
items.title_en: Netflix in a Downturn, Down 26% This Year, US Viewership Down 8.6%, Deutsche Bank Still Buys
paras: Netflix(NFLX-US)今年股價表現明顯承壓，市場對美國觀眾參與度下降及熱門內容不足的疑慮升高，截至9月28日收盤，Netflix股價年初至今已下跌26%，較4月16日創下的近期高點107.79美元更大跌36%。不過，德意志銀行分析師認為，市場目前過度聚焦美國市場的觀看時間變化，忽略Netflix在海外市場持續擴大的觀看參與度，因此近期股價修正可能低估了公司仍具韌性的成長前景。
德意志銀行分析師Bryan Kraft近期將Netflix股票評級由「持有」上調至「買進」，但同時將目標價由100美元下調至95美元。Kraft指出，Netflix目前仍維持健康的成長前景，但市場估值並未充分反映這項潛力。
Netflix今年面臨的主要壓力之一，是美國市場觀看參與度走弱。2026年上半年，美國觀眾在Netflix上的觀看分鐘數較去年同期下降8.6%，使投資人開始擔心串流平台能否維持內容吸引力，以及在美國市場進一步提高觀看時間與廣告變現能力。
然而，同一期間Netflix在美國以外市場的觀看分鐘數反而增加5.4%。德意志銀行認為，Netflix是一家全球化程度高度成熟的串流平台，如果只觀察美國市場的觀看時間，容易低估海外市場對整體業務的支撐。
Kraft指出，Netflix在國際市場的參與度持續提高，加上公司在海外內容製作方面擁有相對廣泛的布局，有助於維持其全球串流市場的領先地位。他也認為，美國市場的觀看趨勢確實需要持續觀察，但內容產業本身具有週期性，單一期間的觀看時間下滑並不必然代表整體商業模式出現結構性轉變。
Netflix今年的股價下跌，也與市場對內容供給的疑慮有關。公司今年推出部分內容未能重現過去熱門作品帶動觀看與討論度的效果，使投資人開始重新評估Netflix成熟市場的成長空間。
Netflix第2季營運數據仍維持成長。公司第2季營收達125.6億美元，較去年同期增加13%，營業利益為41.9億美元，年增11%，淨利34億美元，年增9%。其中美國及加拿大營收年增10%至54.3億美元，歐洲、中東及非洲營收年增14%至40.3億美元，拉丁美洲營收年增21%至15.8億美元，亞太地區營收則年增16%至15.1億美元。
Netflix管理層也指出，單純觀看時數並不能完整反映內容對公司的商業價值。公司表示，直播內容雖然預計只占2026年內容支出的約5%，但觀看時數可能僅占約1%，原因在於直播能夠帶動新會員註冊、廣告營收及話題熱度。Netflix並指出，過去5年有6個新會員註冊高峰日與直播活動有關。
在整體觀看量方面，Netflix第1季至第2季期間的全球觀看時數較去年同期增加2%，增加約15億小時，增幅也略高於2025年同期約1.5%的成長率。公司強調，未來將同時觀察內容品質、種類及觀看數量，而非僅以總觀看時數衡量會員價值。
不過，市場對Netflix的看法並未完全一致。匯豐近期下調Netflix評級，認為Alphabet(GOOGL)旗下YouTube持續從Netflix等串流服務手中爭取觀眾時間，可能構成長期競爭壓力。Wells Fargo也曾將Netflix評級調降至「減持」，並將目標價下調至57美元，反映部分華爾街分析師對Netflix成長速度及資本配置方向的疑慮。
另一方面，德意志銀行認為市場對Netflix美國市場觀看時間下滑的反應可能過度。除國際市場觀看參與度增加外，Netflix近年也持續擴大海外內容製作，並發展廣告、直播、遊戲及其他內容形式，以降低單一內容類型對業績的影響。
Netflix今年也預計從廣告業務取得約30億美元營收，並持續加大直播內容布局，包括女子世界盃等大型活動。公司同時運用生成式人工智慧改善內容搜尋與推薦功能，並已將相關AI技術應用於超過300部內容作品，以提高製作效率。
Netflix第2季財報公布後，市場對第3季展望一度出現較大疑慮。公司預估第3季營收約128.6億美元、每股盈餘82美分，低於分析師預期的130億美元營收及84美分每股盈餘。公司也宣布自2027年1月起，將觀看時數報告頻率從目前的半年一次進一步降低，這項調整讓部分投資人更加關注會員留存及觀看參與度。
截至9月底，FactSet統計的45家華爾街機構中，有28家給予Netflix「買進」評級、17家給予「持有」評級，顯示雖然股價今年大幅修正，但市場對Netflix長期成長能力的看法仍存在明顯分歧。
Netflix目前面臨的核心問題因此逐漸從「串流市場是否仍能成長」轉向「Netflix能否在成熟的美國市場之外，持續將全球觀眾、海外內容、廣告與直播等新成長動能轉化為營收及獲利」。近期股價大幅修正已反映部分悲觀預期，但國際市場觀看時間增加及公司整體營收持續雙位數成長，仍是投資人評估後續表現的重要因素。
paras_en: Netflix (NFLX-US) has seen its stock under clear pressure this year as concerns grow over declining US audience engagement and a lack of hit content. As of the close on September 28, Netflix’s share price is down 26% year‑to‑date and has fallen 36% from the recent high of $107.79 reached on April 16. Deutsche Bank analysts, however, argue that the market is overly focused on changes in US viewing time and is overlooking Netflix’s continued growth in overseas engagement, so the recent price correction may underestimate the company’s resilient growth outlook.

Deutsche Bank analyst Bryan Kraft recently upgraded Netflix’s rating from “Hold” to “Buy,” while lowering the target price from $100 to $95. Kraft notes that Netflix still maintains a healthy growth outlook, but the market valuation does not fully reflect this potential.

One of the main pressures on Netflix this year is weakening viewer participation in the US market. In the first half of 2026, US viewers’ minutes watched on Netflix fell 8.6% year‑over‑year, prompting investors to worry whether the streaming platform can sustain content appeal and increase viewing time and ad‑monetisation in the US.

Conversely, during the same period Netflix’s minutes watched outside the United States rose 5.4%. Deutsche Bank believes that Netflix is a highly mature global streaming platform, and looking only at US viewing time can underestimate the support that overseas markets provide to the overall business.

Kraft points out that international participation continues to rise and that Netflix’s relatively broad footprint in overseas content production helps maintain its leading position in the global streaming market. He also says that while US viewing trends need to be monitored, the content industry is cyclical, and a short‑term dip in viewing time does not necessarily signal a structural shift in the business model.

The stock’s decline this year is also tied to concerns about content supply. Some of the titles launched this year have failed to replicate the viewership and discussion generated by past hits, leading investors to reassess growth opportunities in Netflix’s mature markets.

Netflix’s Q2 operating data still showed growth. Q2 revenue reached $12.56 billion, up 13% year‑over‑year, operating profit was $4.19 billion, up 11%, and net income was $3.4 billion, up 9%. Revenue in the US and Canada grew 10% to $5.43 billion, Europe, the Middle East and Africa grew 14% to $4.03 billion, Latin America grew 21% to $1.58 billion, and the Asia‑Pacific region grew 16% to $1.51 billion.

Management also noted that raw viewing minutes alone do not fully capture the commercial value of content. The company says live content is expected to account for only about 5% of 2026 content spend, yet viewing minutes may represent just about 1% because live events drive new member sign‑ups, ad revenue and buzz. Netflix adds that six of the past five years’ peak new‑member‑registration days were linked to live events.

Overall viewing volume rose 2% year‑over‑year between Q1 and Q2, adding roughly 15 billion hours and slightly outpacing the 1.5% growth rate recorded in the same period of 2025. The company emphasizes that future assessments will look at content quality, variety and viewing quantity rather than relying solely on total minutes to gauge member value.

However, market views on Netflix are not uniform. HSBC recently cut Netflix’s rating, citing YouTube, owned by Alphabet (GOOGL), as a growing competitor for viewer attention that could pose long‑term pressure. Wells Fargo also downgraded Netflix to “Underweight” and lowered its target price to $57, reflecting some Wall Street concerns about Netflix’s growth speed and capital allocation.

On the other hand, Deutsche Bank believes the market’s reaction to the US viewing‑time decline may be excessive. In addition to rising international participation, Netflix has continued to expand overseas content production and is developing advertising, live streaming, gaming and other formats to reduce reliance on any single content type.

Netflix expects to generate about $3 billion in revenue from its advertising business this year and is further expanding its live‑content slate, including major events such as the Women’s World Cup. The company is also leveraging generative AI to improve content search and recommendation, having applied the technology to over 300 titles to boost production efficiency.

After the Q2 earnings release, the market expressed heightened uncertainty about the Q3 outlook. Netflix projects Q3 revenue of roughly $12.86 billion and earnings of $0.82 per share, below analyst expectations of $13 billion and $0.84 per share. The company also announced that, starting January 2027, it will reduce the frequency of its viewing‑time reports from semi‑annual to a lower cadence, prompting some investors to focus more on member retention and engagement.

FactSet data through the end of September shows that of 45 Wall Street firms, 28 rate Netflix as “Buy” and 17 as “Hold,” indicating that despite the sharp stock correction this year, opinions on Netflix’s long‑term growth potential remain divided.

The core issue for Netflix is shifting from whether the streaming market can still grow to whether Netflix can convert global audiences, overseas content, advertising and live‑streaming into revenue and profit beyond its mature US market. The recent steep price correction reflects some pessimism, but rising international viewing time and continued double‑digit revenue growth remain key factors for investors evaluating future performance.

items.title: 美光瞄準人形機器人與自駕車 實體AI料成下一波成長動能
items.title_en: Micron Targets Humanoid Robots and Autonomous Vehicles, Physical‑AI Components Become Next Growth Driver
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，美光(Micron)(MU-US)在AI熱潮中獲益豐厚，其記憶體與儲存晶片是資料中心的重要零組件，支撐從OpenAI的ChatGPT到Anthropic的Claude等各類AI服務，也因此帶動公司營收與股價大幅飆升。
美光周三公布第四季財報，每股盈餘(EPS)達33.42美元，較去年同期的3.03美元暴增1,002%。營收同樣亮眼，從2025年第四季的113.1億美元大增379%，至542.3億美元。
不過，美光的成功可能不只局限於資料中心。在公司第四季財報電話會議的開場談話中，執行長Sanjay Mehrotra指出，他看好「實體AI」帶來的機會，尤其是在自駕車與人形機器人領域。
人形機器人將需要類似的記憶體與儲存容量，這也可能為美光帶來額外的營收機會。
美國汽車工程師學會(SAE)將自動駕駛車輛分為0至5級，其中0級代表沒有駕駛輔助功能，5級則代表完全自動駕駛。Mehrotra表示，隨著技術朝完全自動駕駛發展，車輛對記憶體與儲存容量的需求將大幅增加。
他在電話會議中表示，「自駕車是實體AI首次大規模部署的主要應用，我們相信，隨著時間推進，這項技術將擴展至人形機器人及其他智慧自主系統。」
Mehrotra解釋，「4級及以上自動駕駛車輛的記憶體容量通常超過200GB，而儲存容量則達到數TB，兩者都比目前2級以上及3級半自動駕駛車輛高出一個數量級以上。」
Mehrotra表示，「隨著車輛數量及單一車輛所需記憶體容量預期同步增加，到了本世紀末，實體AI可能成為推動記憶體與儲存需求的重要動力。」
目前已有多家公司投入人形機器人的開發，包括特斯拉(Tesla)(TSLA-US)、Figure，以及現代汽車旗下Boston Dynamics、宇樹科技與Agility Robotics。
不過，人形機器人的銷售目前尚未真正起飛。根據《路透社》報導，2025年全球僅售出約7,000台人形機器人，用於「工業及專業服務」領域。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that Micron (MU‑US) has benefited richly from the AI boom, as its memory and storage chips are key components in data centers, supporting AI services ranging from OpenAI’s ChatGPT to Anthropic’s Claude, which has driven a sharp rise in the company’s revenue and stock price.

Micron announced its fourth‑quarter results on Wednesday, posting earnings per share of $33.42, a 1,002% jump from $3.03 a year earlier. Revenue also surged, climbing 379% from $11.31 billion in Q4 2024 to $54.23 billion.

However, Micron’s success may not be limited to data centers. In the opening remarks of the Q4 earnings call, CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said he sees opportunities in “physical AI,” especially in autonomous‑vehicle and humanoid‑robot markets.
Humanoid robots will require similar memory and storage capacities, which could provide Micron with additional revenue streams.

The Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) classifies autonomous vehicles from Level 0 to Level 5, where Level 0 has no driver assistance and Level 5 is fully driverless. Mehrotra noted that as technology moves toward full autonomy, vehicle demand for memory and storage will increase dramatically.

He said on the call, “Autonomous vehicles are the first large‑scale deployment of physical AI, and we believe that over time this technology will expand to humanoid robots and other intelligent autonomous systems.”

Mehrotra explained, “Memory capacity in Level 4‑plus autonomous vehicles typically exceeds 200 GB, while storage reaches several terabytes—both an order of magnitude higher than today’s Level 2‑plus and Level 3‑half autonomous cars.”
Mehrotra added, “As the number of vehicles and the memory each requires grow in tandem, by the end of this century physical AI could become a major driver of memory and storage demand.”
Several companies are already developing humanoid robots, including Tesla (TSLA‑US), Figure, and Hyundai’s Boston Dynamics, as well as Yushu Technology and Agility Robotics.
But sales of humanoid robots have yet to take off. Reuters reports that only about 7,000 units were sold worldwide in 2025, mainly for industrial and professional‑service applications.

items.title: 兩大隱密訊號揭露 美債拋售潮可能接近尾聲
items.title_en: Two Hidden Signals Reveal US Bond Sell‑off May Be Nearing Its End
paras: 儘管近期美國債券市場賣壓沉重，但本週四 (1 日) 債市出現穩健回升，追蹤長天期美債的 iShares 20 年期以上美國公債 ETF (TLT) 更創下近一個月來最強勁的盤中反彈。
值得注意的是，除了債市本體的反彈外，選擇權市場的兩大冷門訊號，暗示這波美債拋售潮可能已接近尾聲。
訊號一：公用事業 ETF (XLU) 驚現鉅額押注 賣壓恐已落幕
美股開盤約一小時後，公用事業 Select Sector SPDR 基金 (XLU) 突現異常交易。根據 CBOE LiveVol 與 SpotGamma 的數據，一連串選擇權押注將 XLU 的成交量暴推至 30 日平均值的 10 倍。
其中最受矚目的，是一筆規模達 100 萬美元的組合交易，明確押注公用事業類股止跌甚至回升。由於公用事業屬於高股息防禦型產業，隨著近期美債價格下跌、殖利率飆升，高殖利率固定收益產品嚴重分流了資金，導致該類股遭受重創。
據 ThinkOrSwim 統計，XLU 與 10 年期美債殖利率近 30 天的負相關係數高達 -0.94。
具體來看，該名交易員賣出了 5,000 口明年 1 月月中到期、履約價 39 美元的賣權 (Put)，收取 69.5 萬美元權利金；同時賣出相同數量、履約價 42 美元的買權 (Call)，收取 40 萬美元權利金。
當時 XLU 股價正好略高於 39 美元，這項操作意謂著只要到期時股價落在 39 至 42 美元區間，即可獲得最大收益。
這筆交易雖非強烈看漲，卻明確傳遞出市場大戶認為「該類股已跌無可跌、利率極可能已經見頂」的訊號。
事實上，選擇權資金流向早已悄然轉變，Barchart 數據顯示，XLU 的賣權/買權比例 (Put/Call Ratio) 在上月下旬達到 2.67 的 5 個月新高後便一路回落，資金開始轉向買權；SpotGamma 的統計也指出，週四買權買進量估計達 7.4 萬口，而賣權僅有 4,500 口。
訊號二：SOFR 期貨湧入 440 萬美元大單 押注短期利率回落
無獨有偶，芝加哥商品交易所 (CME) 的債券交易池內，隨後也出現一筆高達 440 萬美元的隱藏版巨額交易，同樣暗示利率飆升勢頭正在趨緩。
根據一名不願具名的場內交易員透露，有大戶砸重金買進了 10 萬口明年 3 月到期的 SOFR (擔保隔夜融資利率) 期貨「96.00/96.125」價差買權 (Call Spread)。當時該期貨合約價格約落在 95.51，此舉等於直接押注隔夜利率將回落至今年 6 月時的水準。
該交易員指出：「在週五關鍵非農就業報告公布前夕，市場出現了極大規模的買權卡位。當 10 年期美債殖利率一度衝破 5.3% 關卡後，隨即引發了這波強勁的債市反彈。」
兩大市場訊號交織之下，種種跡象顯示，美債拋售潮尾聲可能比市場想像中更快到來。
paras_en: Despite heavy selling pressure in the U.S. bond market recently, the bond market showed a solid rebound on Thursday (the 1st), and the iShares 20‑Year+ Treasury Bond ETF (TLT), which tracks long‑term U.S. Treasuries, posted its strongest intraday bounce in about a month.
Notably, beyond the rebound in the bond market itself, two obscure signals in the options market suggest that this wave of U.S. Treasury selling may be close to ending.
Signal One: Utility ETF (XLU) Shows Massive Bet, Selling Pressure May Have Finished

About an hour after the U.S. market opened, the Utilities Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLU) displayed abnormal trading. According to CBOE LiveVol and SpotGamma data, a series of options bets pushed XLU’s volume to ten times its 30‑day average.

The most eye‑catching trade was a $1 million combo that explicitly bet on a halt to the decline—or even a rebound—of utility stocks. Because utilities are a high‑dividend defensive sector, recent Treasury price drops and soaring yields have siphoned capital into high‑yield fixed‑income products, severely hurting the sector.
ThinkOrSwim data shows that XLU and the 10‑year Treasury yield have a near‑30‑day negative correlation of –0.94.

Specifically, the trader sold 5,000 put contracts expiring mid‑January next year with a $39 strike, collecting $695,000 in premium, and simultaneously sold the same number of call contracts with a $42 strike, collecting $400,000 in premium.
At the time, XLU was trading just above $39, meaning the position would earn maximum profit if the stock settled between $39 and $42 at expiration.
Although not a strong bullish bet, the trade clearly signals that large market participants believe the sector has “no more room to fall” and that rates are likely near their peak.

In fact, options flow has already shifted: Barchart data shows XLU’s put‑to‑call ratio peaked at a five‑month high of 2.67 in late last month before declining as money moved into calls; SpotGamma estimates that on Thursday 74,000 call contracts were bought versus only 4,500 puts.
Signal Two: $4.4 Million SOFR Futures Order Bets on Short‑Term Rate Decline
Coincidentally, a hidden mega‑trade of $4.4 million also appeared in the CME bond trading pool, again hinting that the surge in rates is easing.

According to an unnamed floor trader, a large player poured heavy money into 100,000 contracts of a March‑next‑year SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate) futures “96.00/96.125” call spread. The futures price was around 95.51 at the time, effectively betting that overnight rates would fall back to June‑year levels.

The trader noted: “On the eve of Friday’s crucial non‑farm payroll report, the market saw a massive buildup of call positions. When the 10‑year Treasury yield briefly broke above the 5.3% barrier, it triggered this strong bond‑market rebound.”
With these two market signals intertwining, the various clues suggest that the tail end of the U.S. Treasury sell‑off could arrive faster than the market expects.

items.title: 7.28%！美國房貸創近3年新高 購屋族每月多付276美元
items.title_en: 7.28%! U.S. Mortgage Rates Hit Near-Three-Year High, Homebuyers Pay $276 More Per Month
paras: 美國房貸利率持續飆升，房地美(FMCC)1日公布的最新數據顯示，截至10月1日當週，美國30年期固定房貸平均利率由前一週的7.03%跳升至7.28%，單週大漲25個基點，創下2022年10月以來最大單週升幅，同時也是2023年11月22日以來最高水準，連續第6週上升。去年同期30年期房貸平均利率為6.34%，顯示一年內已上升94個基點。
15年期固定房貸利率也同步攀升，由前一週的6.42%升至6.60%，遠高於去年同期的5.55%。房地美的調查主要針對傳統、符合貸款規模限制、20%自備款且信用條件良好的購屋貸款，因此實際借款人取得的利率可能因信用、貸款金額、自備款及其他條件而高於或低於這項平均值。
房貸利率這波快速上升，已讓美國購屋族的負擔明顯增加。以40萬美元、30年期固定房貸計算，利率由今年2月底的5.98%升至目前7.28%，每月本息支出大約增加276美元。房貸成本快速攀升，也使部分潛在買家選擇延後購屋，進一步壓抑原本已經偏弱的住宅市場需求。
最新房貸申請數據已反映這項壓力。美國抵押貸款銀行協會(MBA)9月30日公布，截至9月25日當週，全美房貸申請量經季節調整後較前一週下降6%，再融資申請量下滑9%，較去年同期更大減56%；購屋貸款申請量則較前一週下降4%，未經季節調整的購屋申請量較去年同期下降14%。MBA指出，房貸申請量已降至2025年以來最低的週度水準之一。
在利率急升之下，部分借款人也開始轉向浮動利率抵押貸款(ARM)。MBA數據顯示，截至9月25日當週，ARM占全部房貸申請比率升至10.3%，創2025年10月以來最高，主要原因是ARM利率約比固定房貸低80個基點，讓部分購屋族尋求降低短期融資成本的方式。
房貸利率與美國10年期國債殖利率高度相關，並非單純跟隨聯準會政策利率變化。由於30年期房貸本質上是長期融資工具，銀行與房貸機構通常會根據10年期美債殖利率及相關市場利差調整定價，因此當長天期公債遭到拋售、殖利率急升時，房貸成本也會受到直接影響。
近期美國債券市場正經歷劇烈拋售。10年期美債殖利率10月1日一度升至5.34%，創2002年以來最高水準，雖然盤中後段因投資人逢低承接而回落至約5.26%，但整體殖利率仍處於2000年代初期以來罕見的高檔。
長天期美債殖利率飆升的背後，包含能源價格上漲重新推升通膨疑慮、美國經濟活動仍具韌性，以及政府龐大融資需求等因素。9月美債市場出現今年以來最劇烈的季度殖利率上升之一，市場開始重新評估未來通膨及利率路徑，進而推升長天期公債要求的殖利率溢價。
中東戰事也成為近期利率上升的重要背景。美國與以色列自今年2月底對伊朗發動攻擊後，能源供應受到衝擊，原油價格大幅上升，市場擔心能源成本將透過汽油、運輸及生產成本傳導至整體物價。能源價格重新成為通膨風險來源後，債券投資人要求更高殖利率以補償未來通膨的不確定性，進一步推高美債殖利率及房貸利率。
美國政府財政赤字及持續的國債供給同樣受到市場關注。當政府需要大量發行公債籌措資金時，市場必須吸收更多長天期債券；若投資人要求更高殖利率才能承接新增供給，債券價格下跌便會進一步推高整體市場融資成本。
AI與資料中心投資熱潮也增加企業對資金的需求。近年大型科技企業及相關基礎建設業者大舉投入AI運算、資料中心及電力設施，帶動企業融資及資本支出需求增加。在政府大量發債與企業資本需求同時偏高的環境下，市場資金競爭加劇，也成為長期利率居高不下的因素之一。
不過，房貸利率升高並不代表聯準會一定會升息。聯準會主要控制短期政策利率，30年期房貸則受到長天期公債殖利率、通膨預期、金融市場風險溢價及房貸證券化市場等多重因素影響。即使聯準會未來調整政策利率，房貸利率也不一定同步、同幅度變動。
目前聯準會下一次聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議預定於10月27日至28日舉行。市場將密切觀察通膨、就業及能源價格變化，以及長天期美債殖利率是否持續處於高檔。
房市方面，高利率正在與房屋價格偏高、房源不足等問題形成雙重壓力。對已持有低利率房貸的屋主而言，出售房屋後重新購屋可能意味著必須接受明顯更高的融資成本，因此部分屋主傾向繼續持有現有房產，限制市場上的房屋供給。
另一方面，首次購屋族及需要再融資的借款人受到的衝擊更為直接。MBA數據顯示，再融資申請量較去年同期大減56%，而購屋申請量也比去年同期低14%，顯示目前的高利率環境已經同時壓縮購屋與再融資兩大市場。
美國房市因此面臨利率與需求互相牽制的局面。房貸利率持續突破7%，會降低購屋族的負擔能力並推遲部分需求；但如果需求降溫速度快於房屋供給增加，房價又可能維持韌性，使市場難以透過房價大幅修正來抵銷融資成本上升。
今年2月底，30年期房貸平均利率曾短暫降至5.98%，創2022年底以來最低，之後卻在半年多時間內重新升至7.28%。如今利率不僅回到7%以上，更達到近3年高點，意味著美國住宅市場原本期待的融資環境改善尚未出現。
接下來美國房市能否止跌，關鍵仍在長天期美債殖利率、通膨與能源價格走勢。如果10年期美債殖利率維持5%以上，房貸利率短期內很難大幅回落；反之，若通膨壓力減弱、債券市場拋售降溫，長天期殖利率回落，房貸成本才可能重新獲得下降空間。
在目前利率快速上升、房貸申請量同步下滑的情況下，美國住宅市場的交易量及購屋負擔能力將持續受到壓力，而房貸利率是否能從接近3年高點回落，也將成為第四季美國房市及消費需求的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: U.S. mortgage rates continue to surge, with Freddie Mac reporting on the 1st that the average 30‑year fixed‑rate mortgage jumped from 7.03% the week before to 7.28% as of the week ending Oct. 1, a weekly rise of 25 basis points – the biggest weekly increase since Oct. 2022 and the highest level since Nov. 22, 2023, marking the sixth consecutive week of gains. The 30‑year rate was 6.34% at the same time last year, showing a 94‑basis‑point rise over the past year.

The 15‑year fixed‑rate mortgage also climbed, moving from 6.42% to 6.60% week‑over‑week, well above last year’s 5.55% at the same point. Freddie Mac’s survey focuses on conventional loans that meet loan‑size limits, have a 20% down payment and good credit, so actual borrower rates may be higher or lower depending on credit quality, loan size, down payment and other factors.

This rapid rise in mortgage rates has noticeably increased the burden on U.S. homebuyers. For a $400,000, 30‑year fixed loan, the rate increase from 5.98% at the end of February to the current 7.28% adds roughly $276 to the monthly principal‑and‑interest payment. The swift climb in borrowing costs is also prompting some potential buyers to postpone purchases, further dampening demand in an already weak housing market.

The latest mortgage‑application data already reflect this pressure. The Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA) reported on Sept. 30 that for the week ending Sept. 25, seasonally adjusted U.S. mortgage applications fell 6% from the prior week, with refinance applications down 9% and 56% lower than a year ago; purchase‑loan applications slipped 4% week‑over‑week and were 14% lower than a year earlier on an unadjusted basis. MBA said application volume is now among the lowest weekly levels since 2025.

Amid the rate surge, some borrowers are turning to adjustable‑rate mortgages (ARMs). MBA data show that for the week ending Sept. 25, ARMs accounted for 10.3% of all mortgage applications, the highest share since Oct. 2025, driven mainly by ARM rates being about 80 basis points lower than fixed‑rate mortgages, offering buyers a way to reduce short‑term financing costs.

Mortgage rates are closely tied to the yield on the U.S. 10‑year Treasury and do not simply follow the Fed’s policy rate. Because a 30‑year mortgage is essentially a long‑term financing tool, banks and lenders typically price loans based on the 10‑year Treasury yield and related spread, so when long‑term bonds are sold off and yields spike, mortgage costs rise directly.

The U.S. bond market has recently experienced a sharp sell‑off. The 10‑year Treasury yield spiked to 5.34% on Oct. 1, the highest level since 2002, before easing to around 5.26% later in the session as investors bought on dips, but overall yields remain at unusually high levels not seen since the early 2000s.

The surge in long‑term Treasury yields is driven by higher energy prices reviving inflation concerns, resilient U.S. economic activity, and the government’s massive financing needs. In September, the Treasury market saw one of the steepest quarterly yield increases of the year, prompting a reassessment of future inflation and rate paths and pushing up the risk premium demanded on long‑term bonds.

The conflict in the Middle East has also become an important backdrop for recent rate hikes. After the U.S. and Israel launched attacks on Iran at the end of February, energy supplies were disrupted, crude oil prices jumped, and markets feared that higher energy costs would feed through gasoline, transportation and production expenses into overall prices. With energy again a source of inflation risk, bond investors demanded higher yields to compensate for uncertain future inflation, further lifting Treasury and mortgage rates.

The U.S. fiscal deficit and ongoing Treasury issuance are also drawing market attention. When the government needs to issue large amounts of debt, the market must absorb more long‑term bonds; if investors require higher yields to take on the added supply, bond prices fall, pushing up overall financing costs.

The AI and data‑center investment boom is adding to corporate funding demand. In recent years, large tech firms and infrastructure providers have poured money into AI computing, data centers and power facilities, boosting corporate financing and capital‑expenditure needs. With heavy government borrowing and strong corporate capital demand, competition for market funds intensifies, contributing to persistently high long‑term rates.

However, higher mortgage rates do not necessarily mean the Fed will keep raising its policy rate. The Fed mainly controls short‑term rates, while 30‑year mortgages are influenced by long‑term Treasury yields, inflation expectations, market risk premiums and the mortgage‑backed‑securities market. Even if the Fed adjusts its policy rate in the future, mortgage rates may not move in lockstep or by the same magnitude.
The Fed’s next Federal Open Market Committee meeting is scheduled for Oct. 27‑28. Markets will watch inflation, employment, energy prices and whether long‑term Treasury yields stay elevated.

In the housing market, high rates are adding to already‑high home prices and limited inventory, creating a double squeeze. Homeowners with low‑rate mortgages face higher financing costs if they sell and buy again, so many choose to hold onto their properties, limiting supply.

Conversely, first‑time buyers and borrowers seeking refinancing feel the impact more directly. MBA data show refinance applications are down 56% year‑over‑year, and purchase applications are 14% lower than a year ago, indicating the high‑rate environment is compressing both the buying and refinancing markets.

Thus the U.S. housing market faces a tug‑of‑war between rates and demand. Persistently above‑7% mortgage rates erode buyer affordability and delay some demand; but if demand cools faster than new housing supply, prices may stay resilient, making it hard for the market to offset higher financing costs through a sharp price correction.

At the end of February this year, the average 30‑year mortgage rate briefly fell to 5.98%, the lowest since the end of 2022, before climbing back to 7.28% over the next six‑plus months. The rate is now not only above 7% but at a near‑three‑year peak, showing that the hoped‑for improvement in financing conditions for the U.S. residential market has not materialized.

Going forward, the housing market’s trajectory hinges on long‑term Treasury yields, inflation and energy price trends. If the 10‑year yield stays above 5%, mortgage rates are unlikely to fall sharply in the short term; conversely, if inflation pressure eases, bond‑market selling cools and long‑term yields retreat, mortgage costs could start to decline again.

With rates rising rapidly and mortgage applications falling in tandem, the U.S. residential market’s transaction volume and buyer affordability will remain under pressure, and whether mortgage rates can retreat from near‑three‑year highs will be a key gauge for the fourth‑quarter housing market and consumer demand.

items.title: 一年一度HBM定價季登場！三星為2027年HBM4報價鎖4.5美元起　每Gb貴三倍
items.title_en: Annual HBM Pricing Season Begins! Samsung Sets 2027 HBM4 Price Starting at $4.5 per GB, Triple the Cost
paras: 南韓《每日經濟》周五(2日)報導，三星電子正與主要客戶就2027年HBM4記憶體供應合約進行價格談判，尋求將每1Gb單價定在4-5美元區間的中高位，也就是1Gb至少4.5 美元。
報導指出，三星HBM3E記憶體目前單價在1.5 美元左右，明年的HBM4合約價格料將為這一金額的3 倍。
HBM供應量與價格由一年一度的談判確認。三星電子已敲定2027年大部分HBM訂單，價格談判預計本月進入最後階段。
根據集邦諮詢(TrendForce)最新研究，AI伺服器需求持續擴張，HBM與Conventional DRAM仍競逐有限的先進製程及晶圓產能，加上新一代產品的良率與產出提升仍需時間，預估2027年記憶體供應將持續吃緊。
在整體記憶體價格維持上行趨勢的情況下，供應商對2027年HBM漲價態度也更為明確，為反映整體供應持續緊張，以及高價HBM4佔比提升、HBM4E於2027年下半年逐步放量所帶來的影響，TrendForce集邦諮詢上修明年HBM價格展望，預估Blended ASP年增幅度將達121%
paras_en: South Korea’s Daily Economic reported on Friday (the 2nd) that Samsung Electronics is negotiating supply contracts for 2027 HBM4 memory with its major customers, aiming to set the unit price for each 1 Gb in the upper‑mid range of $4‑5, i.e., at least $4.5 per 1 Gb.
The report notes that Samsung’s current HBM3E memory sells for about $1.5 per Gb, and the price for next year’s HBM4 contracts is expected to be three times that amount.

HBM supply volumes and pricing are confirmed through an annual negotiation. Samsung has already locked in most of its 2027 HBM orders, and price talks are expected to enter the final stage this month.

According to TrendForce’s latest research, AI server demand continues to expand, and HBM and conventional DRAM are still competing for limited advanced‑process and wafer capacity. Moreover, yield and output improvements for the next‑generation products will take time, leading to an expectation that memory supply will remain tight in 2027.

With overall memory prices maintaining an upward trend, suppliers are clearer about raising HBM prices for 2027. To reflect ongoing supply tightness and the higher share of expensive HBM4, as well as the gradual ramp‑up of HBM4E in the second half of 2027, TrendForce has upgraded its price outlook for next year’s HBM, forecasting a blended ASP annual growth of 121%.

items.title: 牛市警訊浮現！僅25%標普成分股站上50日線 結構急劇惡化
items.title_en: Bull Market Warning Emerges! Only 25% of S&P 500 Stocks Above 50-Day Line, Structure Deteriorates Sharply
paras: 美股整體指數雖持續維持在歷史高點附近，但若仔細剖析市場內部的流動性與結構，大盤榮景背後正悄然浮現一項重大紅燈警訊：投資人對於「持續看多」的信心正急劇流失。
財經機構《Kobeissi Letter》最新報告指出，目前標普500指數 (S&P 500) 成分股中，僅有 25% 的股票成交價高於其 50 日均線 (MA)，創下今年 4 月以來的最低比例。與今年 8 月中旬高達 70% 的榮景相比，大盤結構出現了令人瞠目結舌的急劇惡化。
除了短期均線潰敗，中長期趨勢同樣不容樂觀。
目前標普僅有 47% 的成分股維持在 200 日均線上方，同樣寫下近半年新低。
此外，截至本週一收盤，紐約證券交易所 (NYSE) 已連續 10 個交易日「創 52 週新低」的個股數量超越「創 52 週新高」者。
在過去 15 個交易日中，更有高達 14 天呈現此類異常警訊。
「市場參與廣度 (Market Breadth) 正以驚人的速度急劇惡化。」《Kobeissi Letter》團隊警告，雖然這未必代表市場即將迎來終極拋售潮，但在未來數週內絕對值得投資人高度提防。
健康的大牛市通常伴隨著廣泛的板塊輪動與個股齊揚。如今「市場廣度惡化」，意味著越來越少的股票能夠支撐指數的高位運作。
回顧第三季，市場資金明顯從受制於高利率與高大宗商品價格的跨國企業撤出，轉而龜縮回抱輝達 (NVDA-US)、Meta (META-US) 等「科技七巨頭」龍頭個股，呈現高度集中化的避險防禦心態。
不過，市場並非全然籠罩在陰霾之中。強勁的企業獲利表現仍是當前股市的重要支柱，如記憶體晶片大廠美光 (MU-US) 最新公布的亮眼財報便提供了有力佐證。
針對當前紛擾的市場氛圍，投資研究機構《SentimentTrader》策略師 Jay Kaeppel 分析：「看空者固然可以列舉出一連串理由——高利率、高估值、糧食與能源價格飛漲、政府債務赤字、大選不確定性以及地緣政治衝突等。但在這些壓力下感到焦慮是正常的，歷史規律表明，市場的『長期歷史天花板』極少在極度狂熱出現前形成。」
Kaeppel 進一步指出，目前市場遠未達到「全員登上瘋狂牛車」的狂熱狀態。
因此，儘管市場廣度惡化與高利率環境預示著美股短期內可能面臨陣痛與修正，但從投資人情緒指標來看，大盤長期運行的多頭頂部可能尚未真正到來。
paras_en: U.S. equity indices remain near historic highs, but a close look at internal liquidity and structure reveals a major red flag: investor confidence in a continued rally is eroding rapidly.

The latest Kobeissi Letter report notes that only 25% of S&P 500 constituents are trading above their 50‑day moving average, the lowest share since April this year. This is a stark contrast to the mid‑August peak of about 70%, indicating a dramatic structural decline.
In addition to the short‑term moving‑average collapse, the medium‑ to long‑term trend is equally bleak.
Only 47% of S&P 500 stocks are now above their 200‑day moving average, also a six‑month low.
Furthermore, as of Monday’s close, the NYSE has seen more stocks make 52‑week lows for ten consecutive trading days than make 52‑week highs.
In the past 15 trading days, this abnormal signal has occurred on as many as 14 days.
"Market breadth is deteriorating at an alarming pace," the Kobeissi Letter team warned. While this may not signal an imminent sell‑off, investors should be on high alert over the coming weeks.

A healthy bull market is usually characterized by broad sector rotation and many stocks pulling the index higher. The current breadth deterioration means fewer stocks are supporting the index’s elevated levels.

Looking back at Q3, capital shifted away from multinational firms weighed down by high rates and commodity prices toward a handful of tech giants such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Meta (META‑US), reflecting a highly concentrated defensive stance.
Nevertheless, the market is not entirely gloomy. Strong corporate earnings remain a key pillar, as demonstrated by Micron Technology’s (MU‑US) impressive latest earnings report.

Commenting on the turbulent market mood, SentimentTrader strategist Jay Kaeppel said, "Bearish investors can list a litany of reasons—high rates, lofty valuations, soaring food and energy prices, government debt deficits, election uncertainty and geopolitical conflicts—but feeling anxious under these pressures is normal. History shows that the market’s long‑term ceiling rarely forms before extreme euphoria takes hold."
Kaeppel added that the market is far from the manic "everyone on the crazy bull cart" frenzy.

Thus, while worsening breadth and a high‑rate environment suggest U.S. equities may face short‑term pain and corrections, sentiment indicators imply that a long‑term bullish top may not have fully materialized yet.

items.title: G7突宣布釋放1億桶戰略儲備！油價跳水後反彈 美伊戰事仍是最大變數
items.title_en: G7 Announces Release of 100 Million Barrels of Strategic Reserves; Oil Prices Rebound After Plunge, US‑Iran Conflict Remains Biggest Variable
paras: 國際油市2日劇烈震盪，WTI原油期貨盤中一度重挫逾5%，最低觸及88.06美元，隨後跌幅大幅收斂，最終以91.26美元作收，下跌1.61美元或1.73%。布蘭特原油(Brent)則在盤中大幅波動後仍守在每桶100美元上方，市場焦點集中在七國集團(G7)宣布釋放戰略石油及柴油儲備，以及美伊戰事是否可能出現新的轉折。
G7由美國、法國、德國、英國、義大利、日本及加拿大組成，目前由法國擔任輪值主席國。法國總統馬克宏2日召集G7領導人舉行視訊會議，與國際能源總署(IEA)討論中東局勢造成的能源供應壓力。會後G7宣布，將透過IEA協調釋放最多1億桶柴油、原油及其他石油產品儲備，行動立即啟動，持續4個月，並將在最初20天大幅提前釋放柴油，以優先緩解目前最緊繃的成品油市場。
G7同時要求成員國協調煉油廠維修時程，避免多座煉廠同時停工，並在可行情況下暫時提高煉油設備利用率；同時加強與具備大型煉油能力國家的合作，以增加柴油等成品油供應。G7也重申，成員國之間不應對能源及能源產品實施出口限制，並呼籲全球能源生產商避免採取可能進一步推升市場緊張程度的出口禁令。
IEA執行董事比羅爾表示，此次釋儲是對柴油供應壓力的直接回應。IEA此前3月宣布的4000萬桶級集體行動，目前約有3.25億桶已經釋放，相當於原先承諾量的逾80%。比羅爾指出，中東原油出口已較危機最嚴重時期明顯恢復，但煉製產品流動仍受到嚴重限制，俄羅斯煉油設施遭到烏克蘭攻擊也進一步壓縮柴油供應，因此柴油市場仍比原油市場更加緊繃。
此次釋儲消息公布後，油價迅速下挫，IEA表示市場在宣布釋儲後一度下跌約5美元，顯示交易員立即將新增庫存供應納入定價。不過，市場並未完全消除對中東供應中斷的疑慮，WTI最終仍收在91美元以上，Brent則維持在102美元左右，反映交易員認為戰略儲備只能部分緩解短期供應缺口，無法完全消除地緣政治風險。
2日的油價走勢也凸顯市場供應結構的變化。前一交易日，Brent大漲4.28美元或4.37%，收在102.31美元；WTI上漲2.45美元或2.71%，收在92.87美元，當時市場受到美國增派軍力、中國暫停部分成品油出口，以及中東供應不確定性升高等因素推動。
除了G7釋儲之外，中東原油供應近期確實出現部分恢復，這也是2日油價回落的重要原因之一。不過，IEA指出，目前真正緊張的環節已逐漸由原油轉向柴油等煉製產品，因此即使原油出口恢復，成品油市場仍可能維持較高價格與較低庫存。
歐洲柴油市場的波動尤其劇烈。2日柴油價格一度大跌逾8%，之後隨著原油跌幅收斂而回升。歐洲此前已受到中東煉廠受損、俄羅斯柴油供應受限及全球成品油庫存偏低等多重因素影響，柴油市場供應壓力明顯高於原油市場。
G7釋儲計畫也與美國政府此前要求歐洲動用緊急柴油庫存有關。此前美國要求德國及法國等歐洲國家增加柴油庫存釋放，以降低燃料價格壓力。歐洲方面原先對大規模消耗戰略庫存有所疑慮，但最終在G7框架下達成協議，並將釋儲與煉油能力調整、能源出口政策協調一併納入。
在能源市場劇烈波動之際，美伊戰事走向仍是油價最大的變數之一。川普2日表示，與伊朗的戰事將「很快結束」，並再次強調伊朗不會擁有核武。不過，美國軍方同時正在增加中東軍事部署，使市場難以將相關言論直接視為衝突即將結束的訊號。
據最新報導，美國正在向中東增派「羅斯福號」航空母艦打擊群，以及由「馬金島號」兩棲戒備群等艦艇組成的部隊，並可能增加最多約1萬名海軍及海軍陸戰隊人員。相關艦艇及人員預計在11月底前後抵達中東。若現有部署持續，未來數月美軍在該區域可能同時維持3個航空母艦打擊群。
目前美國在中東已部署「布希號」及「華盛頓號」航空母艦，後續「羅斯福號」是否將與其中兩個打擊群同時留在當地，仍取決於後續調度。美軍增兵與川普對伊朗的強硬表態，使市場同時面臨「戰事可能降溫」與「軍事升級風險增加」兩股相反力量。
另一方面，荷姆茲海峽的航運安全仍未完全恢復。英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)最新通報，一艘油輪在通過荷姆茲海峽時遭不明發射物擊中並起火，船員均安全，當局目前尚未收到環境污染報告，事件來源及發射物身分仍在調查中。
這並非近期荷姆茲海峽首次發生船舶遇襲事件。UKMTO近期已連續收到多起油輪及其他商船遭不明發射物擊中的通報，部分事件造成火災或船舶受損，相關船隻普遍被要求提高警戒並向UKMTO通報可疑活動。
荷姆茲海峽仍是全球能源運輸最重要的瓶頸之一。雖然近期通過該水道的部分能源運輸量已有所恢復，9月經荷姆茲海峽出口的LNG貨物數量更升至美伊戰事爆發以來最高，但航運業仍面臨安全、保險及運輸成本等問題，市場也持續評估這種恢復能否延續至冬季。
伊朗方面則持續透過外交管道提出重新開放荷姆茲海峽及停止敵對行動的方案。路透報導，伊朗曾透過卡達等中間人向美方提出方案，內容涉及停止戰事、重新開放荷姆茲海峽及解除部分制裁等條件，但川普拒絕接受伊朗提出的方案。伊朗方面則表示，若美國再次發動大規模攻擊，德黑蘭已在準備更強烈的軍事回應。
因此，當前油市形成一個相當特殊的格局：一方面，中東原油出口逐步恢復、G7宣布釋放最多1億桶儲備，短期供應壓力獲得緩解；另一方面，柴油等煉製產品仍然緊張，荷姆茲海峽航運安全也持續受到威脅，加上美國進一步增兵，使市場仍須為新一輪供應中斷保留風險溢價。
對油市而言，未來數週的關鍵將是G7釋儲實際進入市場的速度、柴油庫存下降是否停止，以及荷姆茲海峽航運能否持續恢復。若儲備釋放速度高於市場預期，可能繼續壓低柴油及原油價格；但若美伊衝突重新升級、荷姆茲海峽運輸再度受阻，釋儲帶來的價格緩衝效果則可能迅速被新的供應損失抵消。
paras_en: International oil markets saw extreme volatility on the 2nd, with WTI crude futures plunging more than 5% intraday to a low of $88.06 before the decline narrowed and the contract closed at $91.26, down $1.61 or 1.73%. Brent crude also swung widely but stayed above $100 a barrel, as market focus centered on the G7's announcement to release strategic oil and diesel reserves and on whether the US‑Iran conflict could take a new turn.

The G7, composed of the United States, France, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Japan and Canada and currently chaired by France, held a video conference called by French President Emmanuel Macron on the 2nd to discuss Middle‑East‑driven energy‑supply pressures with the International Energy Agency (IEA). After the meeting the G7 announced that, through the IEA, it will coordinate the release of up to 100 million barrels of diesel, crude and other petroleum products, an action that starts immediately, will run for four months and will front‑load diesel releases in the first 20 days to ease the tightest refined‑product markets.

The G7 also asked member states to coordinate refinery maintenance schedules to avoid simultaneous shutdowns, to temporarily raise refinery utilization where feasible, and to deepen cooperation with countries that have large refining capacity to boost supplies of diesel and other refined products. It reiterated that members should not impose export restrictions on energy or energy products and called on global energy producers to avoid export bans that could further tighten markets.

IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol said the release is a direct response to diesel‑supply pressure. The IEA’s March‑announced collective action of 40 million barrels has already resulted in the release of about 325 million barrels, more than 80% of the pledged amount. Birol noted that Middle‑East crude exports have recovered markedly from the peak of the crisis, but flows of refined products remain severely constrained, and attacks on Russian refineries by Ukraine have further squeezed diesel supplies, leaving the diesel market tighter than the crude market.

After the release announcement, oil prices fell sharply; the IEA said the market dropped about $5 after the news, showing traders immediately priced in the additional inventory. However, concerns about Middle‑East supply disruptions were not fully erased, with WTI closing above $91 and Brent around $102, reflecting traders’ view that strategic reserves can only partially offset short‑term supply gaps and cannot eliminate geopolitical risk.

The price action on the 2nd also highlighted a shift in market supply structure. The previous trading day Brent surged $4.28 or 4.37% to $102.31, while WTI rose $2.45 or 2.71% to $92.87, driven by increased US military presence, China’s temporary halt of some refined‑product exports and heightened Middle‑East supply uncertainty.

Beyond the G7 release, Middle‑East crude supplies have indeed begun to recover, which was another factor behind the price pull‑back on the 2nd. Nonetheless, the IEA pointed out that the real tight spot is moving from crude to refined products such as diesel, so even with restored crude exports, refined‑product markets may stay at elevated prices and low inventories.

European diesel markets were especially volatile. Diesel prices in Europe fell more than 8% on the 2nd before rebounding as crude‑price declines narrowed. Europe has been hit by multiple pressures – damaged Middle‑East refineries, limited Russian diesel supplies and globally low refined‑product inventories – making diesel supply stress noticeably higher than for crude.

The G7 release plan also ties to a prior US request that Europe tap emergency diesel stocks. The United States had asked Germany, France and other European nations to increase diesel‑stock releases to ease fuel‑price pressure. Europe was initially hesitant about large‑scale drawdowns of strategic stocks, but ultimately reached an agreement within the G7 framework, linking releases to refinery‑capacity adjustments and coordinated energy‑export policies.

Amid the market turbulence, the trajectory of the US‑Iran conflict remains one of the biggest variables for oil prices. On the 2nd former President Donald Trump said the war with Iran would “end soon” and reiterated that Iran would not acquire nuclear weapons. At the same time, the US military is increasing its Middle‑East deployments, making it hard for markets to treat his remarks as a clear sign of de‑escalation.

According to the latest reports, the United States is sending the USS Roosevelt carrier strike group and a task force that includes the amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island, potentially adding up to about 10,000 Navy and Marine Corps personnel. The forces are expected to arrive in the Middle East around the end of November. If current deployments continue, the US could be operating three carrier strike groups in the region in the coming months.

The US already has the carriers USS Bush and USS Washington in the Middle East; whether the Roosevelt will join the two existing groups depends on future tasking. The troop buildup together with Trump’s hard‑line rhetoric creates a market environment of mixed signals – a possible cooling of hostilities on one hand and an increased risk of military escalation on the other.

Separately, shipping safety in the Strait of Hormuz remains incomplete. The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile while transiting the strait and caught fire; the crew were safe and no pollution reports have been received yet, with the source of the projectile still under investigation.

This is not the first recent incident of vessels being attacked in the Strait of Hormuz. UKMTO has recently logged multiple reports of tankers and other merchant ships hit by unknown projectiles, some resulting in fires or damage, prompting vessels to increase vigilance and report suspicious activity to the agency.

The Strait of Hormuz remains one of the world’s most critical bottlenecks for energy transport. Although some energy flows through the waterway have resumed, LNG shipments via Hormuz in September rose to the highest level since the US‑Iran conflict began, yet the shipping industry still faces safety, insurance and cost challenges, and markets are assessing whether the recovery can last through winter.

Iran continues to push diplomatic proposals to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and halt hostile actions. Reuters reported that Iran, through intermediaries such as Qatar, offered the US a package that includes ending hostilities, reopening the strait and lifting some sanctions, but Trump rejected the proposal. Tehran says it is ready to respond more forcefully if the US launches another large‑scale attack.

Thus the oil market is in a uniquely mixed state: on one side, Middle‑East crude exports are gradually returning and the G7’s release of up to 100 million barrels eases short‑term supply pressure; on the other, diesel and other refined products remain tight, Hormuz shipping safety is still threatened, and US troop increases keep a risk premium for potential supply disruptions alive.

Looking ahead, the key factors for the oil market over the next few weeks will be the speed at which G7 reserves actually reach the market, whether diesel inventories stop falling, and whether shipping through the Strait of Hormuz can stay restored. If reserve releases outpace expectations, diesel and crude prices could keep falling; but if the US‑Iran clash escalates again or Hormuz shipping is disrupted, the price‑support effect of the releases could be quickly offset by new supply losses.

items.title: 三星HBM4報價逾前代3倍 搶攻AI記憶體定價權
items.title_en: Samsung HBM4 Pricing Over Triple That of Previous Generation, Seeks AI Memory Pricing Power
paras: 據韓國《每日經濟》週五 (2 日) 報導，三星向主要客戶提出的 2027 年 HBM4 供貨報價，落在每 Gb 4 美元的中高價位，超過目前 HBM3E 約 1.50 美元的 3 倍。
三星電子 (005930-KR) 擬以新一代高頻寬記憶體 (HBM4) 的效能優勢拉高售價，挑戰 SK 海力士主導的市場格局。
《每日經濟》引述半導體業界人士指出，三星已展開明年度 HBM4 年度供貨合約談判，希望在產品世代交替之際，將較高的傳輸速度與穩定供貨能力轉化為價格溢價，提升獲利能力。
以效能拉高報價 年度價格談判進入尾聲
三星此次報價的主要支撐，來自對 HBM4 效能的信心。
三星 HBM4 可穩定達到每秒 11.7 Gb 的資料傳輸速度，最高可達每秒 13 Gb，並稱其處於業界最高水準。
不同於一般 DRAM，HBM 主要透過年度長期合約供貨。客戶會提前與製造商協商下一年度的採購量與價格，以確保取得所需供應，製造商則依據訂單安排生產。
據報導，明年度主要 HBM 供貨量已有相當部分完成協商，價格談判預計將在本月進入最後階段。
不過，三星目前提出的是供貨報價，最終成交價格仍取決於與客戶的談判結果。
HBM4 推升競爭門檻 速度與功耗成定價關鍵
隨著 AI 加速器對記憶體效能的要求提高，HBM 市場的競爭重點也逐漸改變。
過去，供應商首先必須通過輝達 (NVDA-US) 等主要客戶的認證、打入供應鏈，再擴大出貨規模。進入 HBM4 世代後，即使是同一代產品，傳輸速度與功耗效率的差異，也將愈來愈影響價格。
三星希望藉此強化競爭力。SK 海力士 (000660-KR) 過去在 HBM 市場居於領先地位，三星則試圖透過更高規格的產品，爭取客戶接受較高售價，並擴大自身的市場影響力。
AI 需求與供應吃緊 支撐價格上行
除了產品效能，AI 基礎建設投資持續擴張，也為 HBM 報價提供支撐。需求快速成長，但供應仍有限，加上 HBM4 將逐步取代現有主力產品，有利於高階產品維持價格溢價。
報導引述研調機構 TrendForce 預測，受 HBM4 占比提高及供應短缺推動，2027 年 HBM 平均售價將較今年上漲 121%。美光 (MU-US) 也在近期財報電話會議中，提及明年 HBM 價格可能大幅上漲。
這項平均售價預測同時反映產品組合轉向價格較高的 HBM4，以及供需吃緊的影響，並不代表所有 HBM 產品都將調漲相同幅度。
隨著三星擴大 HBM4 供應，市場競爭預料將進一步升溫。三星能否讓客戶接受效能溢價，並將技術表現轉化為穩定量產與市占率成長，將成為明年 HBM 市場的觀察重點。
paras_en: According to South Korea's Daily Economy on Friday (the 2nd), Samsung's proposed 2027 HBM4 supply price to major customers falls in the mid‑high range of $4 per gigabyte, more than three times the current HBM3E premium of about $1.50 per gigabyte.
Samsung Electronics (005930-KR) plans to leverage the performance advantage of its next‑generation high‑bandwidth memory (HBM4) to raise prices and challenge the market dominance of SK Hynix.

The Daily Economy quoted semiconductor industry sources saying Samsung has already begun negotiations for HBM4 supply contracts for next year, hoping to convert higher transfer speeds and stable supply capability into price premiums as the product generation shifts, thereby boosting profitability.
Using performance to lift pricing, annual price negotiations are entering the final stage
The main support for Samsung's current pricing comes from confidence in HBM4 performance.
Samsung's HBM4 can consistently achieve a data transfer rate of 11.7 Gb/s, peaking at 13 Gb/s, which the company claims is among the industry's highest levels.

Unlike typical DRAM, HBM is primarily supplied through long‑term annual contracts. Customers negotiate next‑year purchase volumes and prices in advance to secure supply, while manufacturers schedule production based on those orders.
The report says a substantial portion of next year’s main HBM supply volume has already been negotiated, and price talks are expected to enter their final phase this month.
However, Samsung’s current figure is a supply quote; the final transaction price will still depend on negotiations with customers.
HBM4 raises the competitive barrier, with speed and power consumption becoming key pricing factors
As AI accelerators demand higher memory performance, the competitive focus in the HBM market is shifting.

In the past, suppliers first had to pass certification by major customers such as Nvidia (NVDA-US) and enter the supply chain before scaling shipments. In the HBM4 era, even within the same generation, differences in transfer speed and power‑efficiency will increasingly affect pricing.

Samsung aims to strengthen its competitiveness. SK Hynix (000660-KR) has historically led the HBM market, but Samsung is trying to win customers over with higher‑spec products, command higher prices, and expand its market influence.
AI demand and tight supply support price increases

Beyond product performance, continued expansion of AI infrastructure investment also underpins HBM pricing. Demand is growing rapidly while supply remains limited, and as HBM4 gradually replaces existing flagship products, it helps premium products maintain price premiums.

Citing research firm TrendForce, the report forecasts that driven by a higher share of HBM4 and supply shortages, the average HBM price in 2027 will be 121% higher than this year’s. Micron (MU-US) also mentioned in a recent earnings call that next year’s HBM prices could rise sharply.

This average price forecast reflects both the shift toward higher‑priced HBM4 in the product mix and the impact of tight supply, and does not imply that all HBM products will see the same price increase.

As Samsung expands HBM4 supply, market competition is expected to heat up further. Whether Samsung can get customers to accept the performance premium and turn technical performance into stable mass production and market‑share growth will be a key focus for the HBM market next year.

items.title: 馬斯克帝國本周全線狂飆 長期伴侶卻突宣布「被分手」
paras: 特斯拉(Tesla)(TSLA-US)週五(2日)交出了近期最漂亮的單日表現，收漲4.65%，報370.59美元。截至本週初，特斯拉今年累計下跌約21%，在所有科技巨頭中墊底，而這一次，終於迎來一份超出華爾街預期的成績單。
但特斯拉的大漲，只是馬斯克這周的縮影。一周之內，馬斯克幾乎講全了他所有的核心敘事：電動車、自動駕駛、電動卡車、太空、AI算力、超級高鐵，以及政商關係。同時，他的私人生活也再次成為輿論焦點。
點燃股價的，是週五公佈的第三季交付數據。特斯拉本季交付486,532輛。此前，市場普遍不看好：分析師一致預期只有461,974輛，高盛的預測更低，僅約43.5萬輛。最終，實際交付比一致預期多出約2.5萬輛。
這份成績單還有幾個亮點：
庫存清空：交付量比產量多出約2.2萬輛，第一季積壓的約5萬輛超額庫存已基本消化
歐洲回暖：歐洲銷量從去年的低迷中恢復，彌補了美國和中國兩大市場的疲軟
儲能增長：儲能裝機13.7GWh，同比增長9.6%
華爾街的態度明顯轉暖。摩根士丹利認為，特斯拉可能正在「走出電動車寒冬」。

Semi卡車遲到7年終於量產

交付超預期之前，特斯拉已經有好消息。9月24日，Semi電動卡車在內華達州正式開啓大規模量產，首批車輛交付給百事、DHL和US Foods。這家專屬工廠年產能為5萬輛，目標是每周生產1,000輛。就在量產前幾天，特斯拉還贏得了一個最多2,500輛的採購項目，這是Semi迄今為止最大的訂單。
從2017年發佈到實現量產，Semi整整等了7年。
擴產所需的資金也已到位。9月29日，特斯拉宣佈獲得300億美元新信貸額度，用於Cybercab、Optimus和Semi的規模化生產，其中花旗提供200億美元。公司表示，今年不打算動用這些額度。

Starship第14次試飛 終於進入軌道

如果說特斯拉是本週最受關注的消息，那麼SpaceX(SPCX-US)就是本週最具分量的突破。週一，Starship第14次試飛首次進入地球軌道，並部署了全部26顆Starlink V3衛星。過程並不完美：一台發動機在上升階段熄火，原計劃10小時的任務也縮短到約3小時。但核心目標已經達成。
為什麼這步如此關鍵？此前所有Starship試飛都只能走亞軌道路線，最終要麼濺落，要麼在部分測試中損毀。而V3衛星體積太大，Falcon 9無法搭載，只能依賴Starship。每顆V3衛星的下行帶寬超過1Tbps，遠超目前在軌的V2 Mini衛星。
週四，SpaceX又將四名太空人送往國際太空站，執行NASA的Crew-13任務，同時把一顆Google衛星送入軌道。三次任務加起來，SpaceX在約13小時內實現了三次入軌發射。
Google這顆名為Suncatcher的衛星，正測試在軌運行的AI運算硬體，這正是馬斯克一直描繪的「太空算力」圖景。馬斯克本人也在週四晚間透露，憑借與輝達的深度聯合設計，SpaceX有望在其AI硬體上實現一個「大突破」。
週五，SpaceX盤中一度大漲超過7%。摩根士丹利維持「增持」評級和300美元目標價，並認為下一次試飛如果能成功回收飛船，可能成為SpaceX上市以來最大的股價催化劑。

馬斯克再次喊話「超級高鐵」

9月20日，馬斯克在X上表示，Boring Company正在奧斯汀和聖安東尼奧之間建設一條「簡易版的超級高鐵前身隧道」，時速超過200英里，可以把最長約2個半小時的車程穩定縮短到30分鐘以內。
這次與過去最大的不同在於資金。本月早些時候，Boring Company剛完成一輪由阿聯酋投資者領投的30億美元融資，估值約230億美元。
但這個項目目前仍處於非常早期的階段：沒有公佈線路、時間表或造價，也沒有任何公開承諾。兩地交通官員表示，在馬斯克發文前從未與他或Boring Company有過接觸。
馬斯克在2013年首次提出超級高鐵構想。十多年過去，全球仍沒有一條真正載客運營的超級高鐵。這一次，錢已經到位，接下來要看行動。

從白宮主桌到五角大廈

9月29日，川普在白宮舉辦AI午宴。座位圖顯示，馬斯克與輝達CEO黃仁勳分坐川普兩側。
次日，馬斯克又獲得一項新職務：他將與Anduril創辦人Palmer Luckey和前眾議院議長金里奇共同領導五角大廈的「子午線計劃」（Project Meridian）。這是一項為期120天的研究，旨在確定美軍未來作戰所需的新領域和防務技術。

與長期伴侶分手

就在特斯拉公佈交付數據的同一天，馬斯克的私人生活也上了頭條。
週五，馬斯克的長期伴侶、Neuralink高階主管Zilis在X上發文宣佈兩人分手，並稱是馬斯克在毫無預兆情況下結束了這段關係。她寫道，一周之內從相愛到放手很難，但有時事情就是這樣。
Zilis曾在OpenAI工作，與馬斯克育有四個孩子。她在聲明中表示，這四個孩子是兩人多年相處中最重要結晶。
Zilis在回應一條有關馬斯克取消關注她的發文時，透露了分手消息。她寫道，「在毫無預兆的情況下，一周之內從相愛走到被分手，很難接受，但有時事情就是這樣。」她稱自己會非常想念馬斯克。
在這份告別聲明中，Zilis回顧了兩人相處的經歷。她表示，自己曾努力給馬斯克提供穩定、溫和的愛，希望他在繁忙且充滿衝突的生活之外，擁有一個能夠安心休息的地方。
儘管感到失落，Zilis仍感謝兩人共同擁有的四個孩子，並表示希望今後能夠與馬斯克成為好朋友，共同承擔養育責任。「我很難過，但仍深深關心他，也會一直祝福他幸福。」
Zilis還隨聲明發佈了一張日期為9月24日的訊息對話截圖。據《富比世》報導，截圖中，她告訴馬斯克，很高興與他一起吃早餐，並表達愛意，馬斯克回覆稱，他也愛她。
Zilis擔任Neuralink營運與特別專案主管，畢業於耶魯大學，擁有機器學習和AI領域工作背景。她曾於2017年至2019年在特斯拉任職，也曾擔任OpenAI顧問及董事會成員，早早登上富比世30 Under 30精英榜。

items.title: AI資料中心儲存升溫 Toshiba擬倍增HDD產能、WDC與Seagate股價重挫
items.title_en: AI Data Center Storage Heats Up: Toshiba Plans to Double HDD Capacity, WDC and Seagate Stocks Plunge
paras: 2026年10月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心建置熱潮持續擴大，除了GPU、高頻寬記憶體與電力設備外，龐大的資料儲存需求也開始推動傳統硬碟（HDD）業者擴充產能。日本Toshiba計畫在2027會計年度內，將AI資料中心使用的HDD產能提高一倍，以因應AI帶動的儲存需求成長。
消息公布後，市場反而擔憂HDD供給增加可能改變產業供需格局。Western Digital(WDC-US)與Seagate Technology(STX-US)股價周五雙雙重挫約10%，成為標普500科技類股中表現最弱的個股。
近年AI基礎設施投資焦點主要集中在GPU與先進記憶體，但隨著AI模型訓練、推論及資料生成量持續增加，資料中心後端儲存容量也必須同步擴張。相較於高速存取使用的SSD，大容量HDD仍是資料中心儲存大量資料的重要設備，使AI投資熱潮逐步向儲存設備供應鏈延伸。

paras_en: October 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – The AI data‑center construction boom continues to expand. In addition to GPUs, high‑bandwidth memory and power equipment, the massive data‑storage demand is now prompting traditional hard‑disk drive (HDD) manufacturers to expand capacity. Japan’s Toshiba plans to double the HDD capacity used in AI data centers within its fiscal year 2027 to meet the storage growth driven by AI.

After the announcement, the market grew concerned that increased HDD supply could alter the industry’s supply‑demand balance. Western Digital (WDC‑US) and Seagate Technology (STX‑US) shares both fell about 10% on Friday, making them the weakest performers among S&P 500 technology stocks.

In recent years, AI infrastructure investment has focused mainly on GPUs and advanced memory, but as AI model training, inference, and data generation continue to rise, data‑center back‑end storage capacity must expand in tandem. Compared with SSDs used for high‑speed access, high‑capacity HDDs remain essential for storing large volumes of data in data centers, extending the AI investment wave into the storage‑equipment supply chain.

items.title: AI資料中心推升變壓器需求 WEG擴建美洲產能、北美訂單18.5%已來自資料中心
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Boost Transformer Demand; WEG Expands Americas Capacity, 18.5% of North American Orders Now From Data Centers
paras: 2026年10月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心用電需求快速攀升，正同步推高大型電力變壓器與資料中心內部配電設備需求。巴西工業設備大廠WEG(WEGE3-BR)指出，2026年上半年北美變壓器接單中，已有18.5%最終應用於資料中心，AI基礎設施投資已實際轉化為設備訂單。
資料中心對變壓器的需求主要分成兩層。第一層位於資料中心外部，電力必須經由變電站及大型變壓器從電網導入；第二層則進入資料中心內部，由乾式變壓器、Pad-mounted變壓器等設備進一步降壓及配電，再供應伺服器、冷卻等設備。WEG目前可提供最高550 kV變電站解決方案，以及最高500 MVA的大型變壓器。
AI伺服器提高機櫃功率密度後，這套電力架構也必須跟著放大。WEG指出，一般邊緣運算資料中心每個機櫃功率密度約從10 kW起跳，Hyperscale AI Training資料中心目前已超過200 kW，未來甚至可能突破500 kW，使變電站、變壓器及內部配電設備規格同步升級。
從實際專案更能看出變壓器用量。WEG在巴西Ceará州一座資料中心專案共供應124台變壓器，包括3.75 MVA乾式變壓器；另一座São Paulo資料中心則配置26台乾式變壓器。
美國大型資料中心的單機容量更高。WEG指出，其中一項專案採用23台、每台70 MVA的大型變壓器，合計容量約1,610 MVA，進線電壓達138 kV；另一項專案則配置8台、每台250 MVA變壓器，合計容量約2,000 MVA。墨西哥一項資料中心專案則採用14台3.3 MVA乾式變壓器，由WEG哥倫比亞基地供貨。
這代表AI資料中心帶來的需求不只是「多買幾台變壓器」，而是從外部高壓變電站的大型變壓器，一路延伸至資料中心內部數十甚至上百台中小型變壓器，單一大型專案即可形成多層次設備需求。
除了資料中心新建案，既有電網老化也形成另一股需求。WEG表示，巴西部分大型變壓器使用年限已超過40年，美國部分設備甚至接近50年，使目前市場同時面臨AI資料中心新增負載、電網擴建及老舊設備汰換三股需求。
為此，WEG正進行歷來規模最大的變壓器投資週期，同步推進6個生產基地相關投資。其中墨西哥Atotonilco de Tula新廠面積約3.3萬平方公尺，投資7.65億巴西里亞爾（約1.47億美元），預計2027年第1季完成，主要生產供應美國市場的大型變壓器。公司直言，目前美國大型變壓器市場的供需缺口最為明顯。
哥倫比亞新廠面積約2.3萬平方公尺，投資1.09億巴西里亞爾（約2,090萬美元），預計2027年第1季完成，主要供應中型變壓器，並支援墨西哥及中美洲市場。
美國特殊變壓器廠則投資4.13億巴西里亞爾（約7,930萬美元），規劃增加50%產能並提高自動化程度，預計2028年第1季完成，可供應BESS、再生能源及資料中心所需的Pad-mounted變壓器。
巴西方面，Betim廠擴建後總面積將達7.5萬平方公尺，成為WEG全球最大的輸配電設備生產基地；Itajubá廠也持續擴充變壓器產能。Gravataí廠則投資1.28億巴西里亞爾（約2,460萬美元），預計2027年第4季完成，增加中型電力變壓器產能。
WEG估計，排除伺服器後，包括變壓器、變電站、配電及其他電氣化設備在內，公司產品可觸及的市場約占資料中心設施成本15%，並計畫持續補齊產品組合至2030年。

paras_en: October 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The electricity demand of AI data centers is rising rapidly, simultaneously driving up demand for large power transformers and internal distribution equipment in data centers. Brazilian industrial equipment giant WEG (WEGE3-BR) said that in the first half of 2026, 18.5% of transformer orders in North America were ultimately destined for data centers, meaning AI infrastructure investment has already translated into equipment orders.

Transformer demand from data centers is split into two layers. The first layer is outside the data center, where power must be brought from the grid through substations and large transformers; the second layer is inside the data center, where dry‑type transformers, pad‑mounted transformers and similar equipment further step down voltage and distribute power to servers, cooling and other systems. WEG currently offers substation solutions up to 550 kV and large transformers up to 500 MVA.

As AI servers increase rack power density, the power architecture must scale accordingly. WEG notes that a typical edge‑computing data center starts at about 10 kW per rack, while hyperscale AI‑training facilities now exceed 200 kW per rack and could eventually surpass 500 kW, prompting simultaneous upgrades of substations, transformers and internal distribution equipment.

Project data illustrate transformer volumes. In a data‑center project in Ceará, Brazil, WEG supplied 124 transformers, including 3.75 MVA dry‑type units; another project in São Paulo uses 26 dry‑type transformers.

U.S. large‑scale data centers have even higher per‑unit capacity. One project uses 23 units of 70 MVA transformers, totaling about 1,610 MVA with an incoming voltage of 138 kV; another project deploys eight 250 MVA transformers for roughly 2,000 MVA. A Mexican data‑center project employs 14 units of 3.3 MVA dry‑type transformers supplied from WEG’s Colombian base.

This shows that AI data‑center demand is not just “buy a few more transformers” but spans from high‑voltage external substation transformers down to dozens or hundreds of medium‑ and small‑size transformers inside the facility, creating multi‑tier equipment needs in a single large project.

Beyond new data‑center builds, aging grid infrastructure creates another demand driver. WEG says some large transformers in Brazil are over 40 years old, and some U.S. units approach 50 years, meaning the market now faces three simultaneous pressures: added AI data‑center load, grid expansion, and replacement of old equipment.

To meet this, WEG is undertaking its biggest transformer investment cycle ever, advancing investments at six production sites. The new plant in Atotonilco de Tula, Mexico, covers about 33,000 m², with an investment of 765 million Brazilian reais (≈$147 million), slated for Q1 2027, and will mainly produce large transformers for the U.S. market. The company says the supply‑demand gap for large U.S. transformers is the most pronounced.

The new Colombian plant, about 23,000 m², will cost 109 million reais (≈$20.9 million), also targeted for Q1 2027, focusing on medium‑size transformers and supporting Mexico and Central‑America markets.

The U.S. specialty‑transformer facility will invest 413 million reais (≈$79.3 million), planning a 50% capacity increase and higher automation, with completion in Q1 2028, to supply pad‑mounted transformers for BESS, renewable energy and data‑center applications.

In Brazil, the Betim plant’s expansion will bring its total area to 75,000 m², making it WEG’s largest global production base for transmission and distribution equipment; the Itajubá plant continues to expand transformer capacity, while the Gravataí plant is investing 128 million reais (≈$24.6 million) for completion in Q4 2027 to add medium‑size power‑transformer capacity.

WEG estimates that, excluding servers, its products—including transformers, substations, distribution gear and other electrification equipment—cover roughly 15% of total data‑center facility costs, and the company plans to fill out its product portfolio through 2030.

items.title: 升息預期撐美元 摩根士丹利改口看多 DXY年底上看102
items.title_en: Rising Rate Expectations Support the Dollar, Morgan Stanley Reverses Course to Bullish, DXY Expected to Reach 102 by Year-End
paras: 《Marketwatch》報導，投資銀行摩根士丹利 (Morgan Stanley) 外匯策略團隊於近期發布的研究報告中公開承認預測失誤，表示原先看空美元的理由已不復存在，並同步調升今年底至 2027 年的美元指數與主要貨幣目標價。
衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣價值的美元指數 (DXY) 近期強勢走高，本週攀升至 101 附近，創近八週新高。美元走強雖提升了美國民眾海外消費的購買力，卻也令美國出口商品成本上升。近期連美國總統川普在會晤日本首相高市早苗時，亦公開提及對日元過度貶值的關切。
由 David S. Adams 領軍的小摩外匯策略團隊在報告中坦言：「我們錯了！」
小摩團隊先前預期美元將於今年下半年持續下行、年底觸底，並至 2027 年轉強，該預測建立在美國與全球利差將縮小、聯準會 (Fed) 暫停升息而其他央行追趕的假設上。
然而，居高不下的能源價格與強勁的美國經濟數據，促使聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 展現偏鷹派政策立場，使美國進一步升息的可能性大幅增加。
根據 CME FedWatch 利率期貨數據顯示，市場預期 Fed 於 10 月會議升息 1 碼 (至 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間)) 的機率已達 68.6%，12 月再度升息 1 碼的機率亦超過五成。
摩根士丹利指出，市場仍有相當大的空間繼續推升升息預期，這將為美元提供穩固的支撐力量。
因應基本面變化，摩根士丹利全面調升美元目標價：

將今年底美元指數預測由原先的 96 大幅上修至 102；
歐元兌美元由 1.20 下調至 1.12 美元；
英鎊兌美元由 1.38 下調至 1.30 美元；
美元兌日元則由 157 上調至 159 日元。


展望 2027 年年中，隨著歐洲政治與財政疑慮再現，預期美元指數將上看 104，歐元兌美元可能進一步走軟至 1.10 美元。在交易策略上，團隊建議可於美元兌日元 158 時建立多頭部位，目標價看 163 日元，停損價設於 150 日元。
不過，摩根士丹利亦提出幾點風險警示。
首先，美元此波強勢主要集中於對抗日元、歐元及瑞士法郎等低利率融資貨幣，而澳元及挪威克朗等商品貨幣仍將維持相對強勢。
其次，部分貶值預期已反映於市場期權價格中，變動幅度可能相對有限。
最後，政治與政策等突發事件仍可能引發震盪，例如關稅政策宣佈或外匯干預等黑天鵝事件，都可能引發美元多頭部位的連鎖停損賣壓。
事實上，不僅是小摩，一些投行也紛紛看多美元。
德國商業銀行分析師 Thu Lan Nguyen 指出，Fed 9 月一致決議升息，暫時恢復了市場對其政策可信度的信心，並支撐美元。該行因此將今年底歐元兌美元預測從 1.17 下修至 1.15，預期 Fed 年底前還會升息一次；此前該行預估 Fed 將維持利率不變。
展望 2027 年，德國商業銀行認為，美國及歐元區的升息預期都可能下修，但美元承受的壓力將更大，歐元兌美元可望逐步回升。
該行預期 Fed 今年 12 月升息後，利率將維持至 2027 年底，同時認為若中東危機逐漸緩和、通膨衝擊消退，Fed 在 2027 年底前也有降息的可能；白宮對 Fed 獨立性的影響，則是美元的另一項壓力來源。

日元方面，MUFG 預期日本央行將在 2027 年 1 月及 6 月再度升息，使政策利率升至 1.75%。因此，雖然美元兌日元短期可能續漲，後續升息及匯市干預風險仍會限制漲幅；該行預期，匯價在突破 160 日元前，買盤就可能減弱。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley’s foreign‑exchange strategy team publicly admitted a forecasting error in a recent research report, stating that the reasons for a short position on the dollar no longer exist and simultaneously raised its year‑end to 2027 targets for the dollar index and major currencies.

The dollar index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, has recently surged, climbing to around 101 this week and setting a new high for nearly eight weeks. While a stronger dollar boosts the purchasing power of U.S. consumers abroad, it also raises the cost of U.S. exports. President Trump recently voiced concerns about the excessive depreciation of the yen during a meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.
Led by David S. Adams, the Morgan Stanley FX team admitted, “We were wrong!”

The team had previously expected the dollar to continue falling in the second half of the year, bottoming out by year‑end and strengthening by 2027, based on assumptions that U.S. and global interest‑rate spreads would narrow, the Fed would pause rate hikes while other central banks would catch up.

However, persistently high energy prices and robust U.S. economic data have prompted the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) to adopt a hawkish stance, greatly increasing the likelihood of further U.S. rate hikes.

CME FedWatch futures data show that the market now assigns a 68.6% probability to a 25‑basis‑point hike at the October meeting (raising the policy range to 4.00%–4.25%) and more than 50% probability of another 25‑basis‑point hike in December.
Morgan Stanley notes that there remains substantial room for the market to further lift rate‑hike expectations, which would provide solid support for the dollar.
In response to changing fundamentals, Morgan Stanley has fully revised its dollar targets:

The year‑end DXY forecast has been sharply raised from 96 to 102; the EUR/USD forecast has been lowered from 1.20 to 1.12; the GBP/USD forecast has been lowered from 1.38 to 1.30; and the USD/JPY forecast has been raised from 157 to 159.

Looking ahead to mid‑2027, as European political and fiscal concerns resurface, the dollar index is expected to rise to 104, with the euro potentially softening further to 1.10. In trading terms, the team recommends taking a long position at USD/JPY 158 with a target of 163 and a stop‑loss at 150.
Nonetheless, Morgan Stanley issued several risk warnings.

First, the dollar’s recent strength is mainly focused on countering low‑rate currencies such as the yen, euro, and Swiss franc, while commodity currencies like the AUD and NOK will remain relatively strong.
Second, some depreciation expectations are already reflected in market option prices, so the upside may be limited.
Finally, political and policy shocks—such as tariff announcements or foreign‑exchange interventions—could trigger chain stop‑loss selling of dollar long positions.
In fact, it is not only Morgan Stanley; other investment banks are also bullish on the dollar.

German commercial bank analyst Thu Lan Nguyen noted that the Fed’s unanimous rate hike in September temporarily restored market confidence in its policy credibility and supported the dollar. The bank therefore lowered its year‑end EUR/USD forecast from 1.17 to 1.15 and expects another Fed hike before year‑end, after previously predicting a pause.

Looking to 2027, the German commercial bank believes that U.S. and euro‑area rate‑hike expectations may be cut, but the dollar will face greater pressure, and the euro may gradually recover against the dollar.

The bank expects the Fed to keep rates unchanged after the December 2023 hike until the end of 2027, and if the Middle‑East crisis eases and inflationary shocks subside, the Fed could also cut rates before the end of 2027; the White House’s influence on Fed independence is another pressure source for the dollar.
(Duplicate paragraph 18 and 19 omitted for brevity)

MUFG’s September 18 report stated that Fed hikes and hawkish signals support the dollar, while the Bank of Japan’s post‑hike stance fell short of market expectations, leaving short‑term upside for USD/JPY. However, MUFG did not significantly raise its dollar forecast, still projecting a 4.2% decline in the DXY by Q2 2027 from the report’s level, as other G10 central banks may continue to hike, potentially preventing spreads from widening favorably for the dollar.

Regarding the yen, MUFG expects the Bank of Japan to hike again in January and June 2027, raising the policy rate to 1.75%. Thus, while USD/JPY may continue to rise in the short term, subsequent hikes and intervention risk will likely cap gains; the bank expects buying pressure to weaken before the 160‑yen breakout.

items.title: 9月就業僅增2.9萬人 Fed可能放緩升息？Hammack：不急著決定下一步
items.title_en: September Jobs Up Only 29,000; Fed May Slow Rate Hikes? Hammack: No Rush to Decide Next Move
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁、2026年FOMC票委Hammack周五(2日)表示,聯準會在決定下一步貨幣政策前仍有充足時間評估最新經濟數據,暗示即使9月就業報告明顯疲弱,決策官員仍不急於在10月底的政策會議上採取行動。
Hammack接受PBS NewsHour訪問時表示,9月非農就業數據雖然表面上相當疲弱,但整體仍符合近期美國就業市場的發展趨勢。美國勞工部當天公布,9月非農就業人口僅增加2.9萬人,遠低於經濟學家預期的約9萬人,失業率則由8月的4.1%升至4.2%。
Hammack指出,如果拉長觀察時間,過去12個月美國平均每月新增就業約4.1萬人,大致符合她對維持勞動市場穩定所需的「損益平衡」就業增幅估計。因此,她認為最新數據並未完全改變對就業市場的判斷,而是延續近期招聘速度放緩的趨勢。
她表示,聯準會在10月底的下一次政策會議前仍會取得更多經濟資訊,因此現在仍有時間判斷最合適的貨幣政策立場。聯準會下一次聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議預定於10月27日至28日舉行。
聯準會9月會議已將聯邦基金利率目標區間上調25個基點至3.75%至4%,並在最新經濟預測中暗示今年底前可能再升息一次。不過,近期多名聯準會官員表示,沒有必要急於在10月會議立即再次升息,決策仍將取決於後續通膨、就業及經濟活動數據。
Hammack長期以來是聯準會內部較早主張升息以抑制通膨的官員之一。她此前多次表示,美國通膨仍高於聯準會2%的長期目標,如果價格壓力沒有進一步降溫,貨幣政策可能需要維持限制性立場,甚至進一步升息。Hammack 是2026年的FOMC票委，而且是有投票權的成員。
她9月25日曾表示,美國通膨持續高於目標超過5年,最大的風險之一是民眾逐漸形成接受高物價的通膨心態。她當時指出,聯準會需要確保政策維持在足夠限制性的水準,以推動通膨回到2%目標。
不過,最新就業數據讓聯準會面臨更加複雜的政策取捨。9月新增就業2.9萬人,不僅遠低於市場預期,8月新增就業人數也遭下修。失業率從4.1%升至4.2%,顯示勞動市場降溫程度正在加深。
市場因此大幅降低10月升息的預期。利率期貨數據顯示,截至周五,投資人預期聯準會10月會議升息的機率已降至不到20%,低於數據公布前的逾25%。市場同時下調12月升息押注,但仍認為今年底前再次升息存在相當可能性,12月升息機率仍接近90%。
政策預期的變化反映聯準會目前面臨兩項相互牽制的風險。一方面,通膨仍高於2%目標,能源價格上升以及地緣政治衝突可能進一步推升價格壓力；另一方面,如果聯準會持續升息或讓利率在高檔維持過久,則可能加劇就業市場降溫並對經濟活動造成壓力。
近期能源價格成為聯準會評估通膨的重要變數。伊朗戰事及中東能源供應受到干擾後,油價明顯上升,可能透過汽油、運輸及生產成本向其他商品與服務傳導。聯準會官員因此必須判斷近期通膨升溫究竟是短期能源衝擊,還是會進一步擴散至更廣泛的核心價格。
聯準會主席Kevin Warsh近期並未明確透露下一次升息的時間,但曾表示,如果政策制定者無法確認潛在通膨正以足夠速度朝2%目標下降,聯準會仍有進一步工作的必要。
紐約聯準銀行總裁John Williams本周也表示,政策官員目前沒有立即升息的急迫性,需要先觀察更多數據,但他仍認為今年底前再次升息具有合理性。聯準會副主席Philip Jefferson則表示,未來任何政策調整都應根據數據趨勢、經濟前景及風險平衡作出判斷,決策官員可能需要更多時間。
目前聯準會政策利率已處於3.75%至4%的區間,高於今年稍早的水準。9月會議公布的預測顯示,多數官員仍認為今年底前需要進一步收緊政策,但最新就業數據使10月立即升息的可能性明顯降低。
對Hammack而言,9月就業數據並不足以單獨決定政策方向。她強調,在10月27日至28日會議前仍有大量資料可供分析,包括通膨、就業及其他經濟活動指標。聯準會將在取得更多數據後,再決定如何在抑制通膨與維持就業市場穩定之間取得平衡。
市場目前因此將焦點轉向接下來公布的通膨數據及聯準會9月會議紀要。若通膨持續高於預期,政策官員可能重新提高對年底升息的支持；若就業市場進一步惡化,則可能增加聯準會暫緩升息的理由。10月底會議前的數據走向,將成為決定聯準會今年最後一次政策調整時機的關鍵。
paras_en: Federal Reserve (Fed) Cleveland Fed President and 2026 FOMC voting member Hammack said on Friday the Fed still has ample time to assess the latest economic data before deciding its next monetary policy step, suggesting that even with a clearly weak September jobs report, policymakers are not in a hurry to act at the policy meeting at the end of October.

In an interview with PBS NewsHour, Hammack noted that while September non‑farm payrolls look weak on the surface, they are still consistent with the recent trend in the U.S. labor market. The Labor Department reported that non‑farm employment rose by only 29,000 jobs in September, far below economists’ estimate of about 90,000, and the unemployment rate rose from 4.1% in August to 4.2%.

Hammack pointed out that over the past 12 months the U.S. has added an average of roughly 41,000 jobs per month, which roughly matches her estimate of the “break‑even” hiring pace needed to keep the labor market stable. Therefore, she believes the latest data does not fundamentally change her view of the labor market, but rather continues the recent slowdown in hiring speed.

She said the Fed will obtain more economic information before its next policy meeting at the end of October, so there is still time now to determine the most appropriate monetary‑policy stance. The next Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting is scheduled for October 27‑28.

The Fed’s September meeting raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%‑4.0% and, in its latest economic projections, hinted at a possible additional hike before the end of the year. However, several Fed officials recently have said there is no need to rush into another hike at the October meeting; the decision will depend on subsequent inflation, employment and activity data.

Hammack has long been one of the Fed’s earlier voices advocating rate hikes to curb inflation. She has repeatedly said U.S. inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% long‑run target and, if price pressures do not ease further, policy may need to stay restrictive or even tighten further. Hammack is a voting member of the 2026 FOMC.

On September 25 she warned that U.S. inflation has stayed above target for more than five years, and one of the biggest risks is that the public gradually becomes accustomed to high‑price inflation. She said the Fed must keep policy sufficiently restrictive to bring inflation back to the 2% goal.

Nevertheless, the latest jobs data complicates the Fed’s policy calculus. September’s addition of 29,000 jobs was far below expectations, and August’s job gains were also revised down. The unemployment rate’s rise from 4.1% to 4.2% shows a deepening cooling of the labor market.

As a result, markets have sharply trimmed expectations for an October hike. Futures data showed that by Friday investors’ probability of a rate increase at the October meeting had fallen to under 20%, down from more than 25% before the data release. The market also lowered its December hike bets, though it still sees a fairly high chance—near 90%—of another hike before year‑end.

The shift in policy expectations reflects two opposing risks the Fed now faces. On one hand, inflation remains above the 2% target, with rising energy prices and geopolitical tensions potentially adding further price pressure; on the other hand, continued tightening or keeping rates high for too long could further cool the labor market and weigh on economic activity.

Recent energy price movements have become a key variable in the Fed’s inflation assessment. After the Iran conflict and disruptions to Middle‑East energy supplies, oil prices rose noticeably, potentially passing through higher gasoline, transportation and production costs to other goods and services. Fed officials therefore must judge whether the recent inflation uptick is a short‑term energy shock or could spread to broader core prices.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has not explicitly indicated the timing of the next hike, but he has said that if policymakers cannot confirm that underlying inflation is falling toward the 2% goal at a sufficient pace, further action may be needed.

New York Fed President John Williams said this week that policymakers do not feel an immediate urgency to raise rates and need to observe more data, though he still believes a year‑end hike remains reasonable. Vice‑Chair Philip Jefferson added that any future policy adjustment should be based on data trends, economic outlook and risk balance, and that officials may need more time.

The Fed’s policy rate is currently in the 3.75%‑4.0% range, higher than earlier this year. The September projections showed most officials still thought further tightening would be required before year‑end, but the latest jobs data has markedly reduced the odds of an immediate October hike.

For Hammack, September’s jobs numbers alone are insufficient to dictate policy direction. She emphasized that a large amount of data—including inflation, employment and other activity indicators—will be available for analysis before the October 27‑28 meeting. The Fed will decide how to balance inflation control with labor‑market stability after gathering more information.

Markets have now shifted focus to upcoming inflation releases and the Fed’s September meeting minutes. If inflation stays above expectations, officials may renew support for a year‑end hike; if the labor market worsens further, they may find more reason to pause. The data trajectory before the end‑October meeting will be pivotal in timing the Fed’s final policy move of the year.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元連續第3周上漲 美債殖利率與Fed鷹派立場支撐
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Rises for Third Consecutive Week, U.S. Treasury Yields and Fed Hawkish Stance Provide Support
paras: 美元周五(2日)下跌，但仍連續第4周兌歐元走升。在歐洲政府公債遭遇拋售、以及市場預期聯準會(Fed)將維持鷹派升息立場的背景下，美國公債殖利率維持高檔，為美元提供支撐。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報101.88，仍連續第3周上漲。
美國公布9月就業成長低於經濟學家預期、失業率小幅升至4.2%後，美元近期部分漲幅有所收斂。10年期美國公債殖利率也在數據公布後下滑，隨後回升5.14個基點至5.285%。
儘管如此，美元仍受到多項因素支撐，包括美國公債殖利率維持在數十年高點附近、部分歐洲國家財政前景的疑慮升溫，以及油價上漲。原油價格走高促使部分投資人降低對主要能源進口國貨幣的曝險，包括歐元與日元。
歐元對美元上漲0.13%，至1.12580美元。歐元兌美元連續第4周下跌，創下2025年5月中旬以來最長連續周跌勢。
野村G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning表示，「如果把這些就業數據放在一起看，我認為這其實是一組相當理想的金髮女孩(Goldilocks)數據：經濟活動仍相當具韌性，但並未產生明顯的通膨壓力。」
他表示，「從整體經濟角度來看，這是個不錯的背景。對整體風險資產及高Beta貨幣而言，這應該是相對有利的數據。這對聯準會利率定價的影響可能也不大，但至少降低了聯準會是否會在10月再次升息的尾部風險。」
美國央行在9月政策會議結束後升息，並釋放進一步升息的訊號。儘管美國總統川普一再要求降低借貸成本，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)仍重申貨幣政策的獨立性。市場對此做出反應，提高了對聯準會進一步緊縮政策的押注。
根據CME Group的FedWatch工具，交易員目前預期聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為86%，高於一周前的36%。
美元兌瑞郎下跌0.30%，至0.8285瑞郎。
美元兌日元也下跌0.15%，至每美元157.81日元，但仍連續第3周上漲。
歐洲市場的擔憂
歐洲國家周五同意釋放柴油庫存。美國總統川普此前曾施壓各國政府採取這項措施，希望壓低與伊朗戰爭相關、持續飆升的燃料價格。
未來幾個月歐元區通膨率可能進一步上升，使歐洲央行(ECB)面臨升息壓力。
近幾周，法國與義大利政府公債持續承受賣壓，市場預期政策利率將上升，加上2027年大選逼近、政治風險升高，使市場更加謹慎。法國10年期公債殖利率周四飆升至2002年以來最高水準。
周五，法國10年期公債殖利率相較避險性較高的德國公債殖利率溢價擴大至150個基點以上，創2011年底以來最高，因市場對法國財政狀況與政治動盪的擔憂加劇。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Friday (the 2nd) but still posted its fourth straight weekly gain against the euro. With European sovereign bonds under pressure and markets expecting the Federal Reserve to maintain a hawkish rate‑hike stance, U.S. Treasury yields stayed elevated, underpinning the greenback.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.1% to 101.88, marking a third consecutive week of rise.

After the U.S. reported September job growth below economists’ forecasts and a modest rise in the unemployment rate to 4.2%, the dollar’s recent gains moderated. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield also fell after the data release, then rebounded 5.14 basis points to 5.285%.

Nevertheless, the dollar remains supported by several factors, including Treasury yields lingering near multi‑decade highs, growing doubts over the fiscal outlook of some European nations, and higher oil prices. Rising crude has prompted some investors to cut exposure to currencies of major energy‑importing countries, such as the euro and the yen.
The euro rose 0.13% against the dollar to $1.12580. The euro‑dollar pair has now slipped for four straight weeks, the longest weekly decline streak since mid‑May 2025.

Nomura G10 FX strategy head Dominic Bunning said, “If you look at these employment numbers together, I think they actually represent a fairly Goldilocks set of data: economic activity remains quite resilient, yet there’s no clear inflationary pressure.”

He added, “From an overall economic perspective, that’s a decent backdrop. For risk assets and high‑beta currencies, it should be relatively favourable. The impact on Fed rate pricing may be limited, but at least it reduces the tail‑risk of another Fed hike in October.”

The U.S. central bank raised rates after its September policy meeting and signaled the possibility of further hikes. Although President Trump repeatedly urged lower borrowing costs, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated the independence of monetary policy. Markets reacted by increasing bets on additional Fed tightening.
According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, traders now assign an 86% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged later this month, up from 36% a week earlier.
The dollar fell 0.30% against the Swiss franc, to 0.8285 CHF per dollar.
The dollar also slipped 0.15% against the yen, to ¥157.81 per dollar, but still posted a third straight weekly gain.
European market concerns

European countries on Friday agreed to release diesel inventories. President Trump had previously pressured governments to take this step, hoping to curb fuel prices that have surged amid the war with Iran.
In the coming months, euro‑area inflation could rise further, putting pressure on the European Central Bank to hike rates.

In recent weeks, French and Italian sovereign bonds have faced sustained selling pressure as markets anticipate higher policy rates. With the 2027 election looming and political risk rising, investors have become more cautious. French 10‑year yields spiked on Thursday to their highest level since 2002.

On Friday, the spread between French 10‑year yields and the relatively safer German 10‑year yields widened to over 150 basis points, the widest since the end of 2011, reflecting heightened concerns over France’s fiscal health and political turmoil.
The euro fell 0.15% against the Swiss franc, to 0.9327 CHF per euro.
The euro was flat against the yen at ¥177.67 per euro.
